items.title: 美國八州控告OpenAI！指ChatGPT危害兒童並欺騙家長
items.title_en: Eight U.S. States Sue OpenAI, Claiming ChatGPT Harms Children and Deceives Parents
paras: 美國八個州周三(14日)分別對OpenAI提起訴訟，指控這家人工智慧(AI)公司旗下的ChatGPT聊天機器人是不安全的產品，已傷害兒童並欺騙家長。
愛荷華州檢察長Brenna Bird表示，愛荷華州、堪薩斯州、內布拉斯加州、西維吉尼亞州、阿肯色州、亞利桑那州、愛達荷州及蒙大拿州，已各自在州法院對OpenAI提告。Bird指出，愛阿華州的訴訟旨在維護受到OpenAI「蓄意、危險、魯莽且違法」行為影響的民眾權益。
Bird說：「OpenAI一方面宣稱ChatGPT安全，另一方面卻提供危險的醫療建議、鼓勵傷害他人，甚至指導使用者輕生，還假裝是使用者的朋友。」她強調，訴訟目的是保護兒童，並依州法追究OpenAI責任。
OpenAI發言人Drew Pusateri表示，該公司已在產品中建立針對不同年齡層的保護機制，這是許多其他AI產品所欠缺的。OpenAI也正與各州合作，推動適用於整個產業的政策。
Pusateri說，沒有任何系統能做到完美，但公司將持續與專家合作，增設防護措施，包括家長監護功能、休息提醒及符合年齡需求的模型保護機制。
OpenAI近來面臨日益升高的安全審查。在多起非正常死亡訴訟中，ChatGPT被指導致使用者陷入有害妄想，部分案例甚至涉及輕生。佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier也在6月控告OpenAI，指控該公司明知產品可能危害使用者，仍推出不安全的產品。
過去一年來，OpenAI陸續強化家長與兒童安全功能，並於8月推出專為未成年人設計的「ChatGPT for Teens」，透過教育功能及符合年齡需求的防護措施，減少青少年接觸不適齡或有害內容。
OpenAI當時表示，青少年應能利用AI學習、創作與探索，但也應獲得符合其發展階段的保護，並維護現實人際關係及健康使用習慣。
paras_en: On Wednesday, the 14th, eight U.S. states filed lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging that the company’s ChatGPT chatbot is an unsafe product that has harmed children and misled parents.

Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana have each filed suits against OpenAI in their state courts. Bird noted that Iowa’s lawsuit aims to protect the rights of people affected by OpenAI’s “deliberate, dangerous, reckless and unlawful” conduct.

Bird said, “OpenAI claims ChatGPT is safe while it provides dangerous medical advice, encourages harm to others, even guides users toward suicide, and pretends to be a friend.” She emphasized that the suit is intended to protect children and hold OpenAI accountable under state law.

OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has built age‑specific safety mechanisms into its product, something many other AI offerings lack, and that OpenAI is working with the states to develop industry‑wide policies.
Pusateri added that no system is perfect, but the company will keep working with experts to add safeguards, including parental‑control features, break reminders and age‑appropriate model protections.

OpenAI has recently faced heightened safety scrutiny. In multiple wrongful‑death suits, ChatGPT was alleged to have driven users into harmful delusions, with some cases involving suicide. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier also sued OpenAI in June, accusing the firm of releasing an unsafe product despite knowing it could endanger users.

Over the past year, OpenAI has incrementally strengthened parental and child safety tools and in August launched a teen‑focused version, “ChatGPT for Teens,” which uses educational features and age‑appropriate safeguards to limit minors’ exposure to unsuitable or harmful content.

OpenAI said at the time that teenagers should be able to use AI for learning, creation and exploration, but also deserve protections suited to their developmental stage, while maintaining real‑world relationships and healthy usage habits.

items.title: 四年2度遇能源衝擊！歐盟今急召特別峰會急商對策　專家曝「1情況」恐讓各國沒招了
items.title_en: Four Years, Twice Hit by Energy Shock! EU Calls Emergency Special Summit Today to Discuss Counter‑measures – Expert Warns One Scenario Could Leave Nations Without Options
paras: 美伊戰事持續推升能源價格，歐洲冬季能源危機警報再響，歐盟領袖今(15)日起在布魯塞爾舉行為期兩天特別峰會，能源成本成為討論競爭力的核心議題。外媒最新報導稱各國將要求歐盟執行委員會提出更多短期措施，但未列出具體方案。
根據歐盟執委會估算，美伊戰爭爆發至今，歐洲化石燃料進口支出已增加逾1000億歐元(約1110億美元)，目前距冬季供暖季不到一個月，歐洲天然氣庫存卻已降至歷史低位。
一位匿名歐盟高官表示，歐執會將向各國領袖坦言，應對高能源價格「不存在一勞永逸的辦法」。
歐洲改革中心研究員Elise Viadere指出，歐洲四年內二度遭遇能源衝擊，但此次公共債務與融資成本都更高，政策迴旋空間明顯縮小。
歐盟正考慮延長聯合能源採購機制、延後化石燃料進口甲烷排放的氣候規則，並延長受衝擊產業的國家補貼，但歐洲油氣進口依賴難解，短期內都難以直接壓低價格。
歐盟各國提出的紓困方案也受財力所限；義大利總理梅洛尼週三(14日)稱接近與歐執會達成協議，對發電用天然氣設價格上限；德國總理梅爾茨則提議大幅削減所有消費者電力稅，但資金來源仍不明朗。
超額利潤稅是另一個爭議焦點。歐執會正評估是否課徵全歐範圍的能源企業暴利稅，構想類似2022年俄烏戰爭後的「團結貢獻」措施，當時能源企業超額利潤實際稅率達33%，歐盟還對風能、太陽能等邊際成本較低的發電業者設收入上限。
但新一輪課稅恐遭部分成員國反對，決策者擔心壓低利潤的同時，也會削弱煉油業投資動能，且歐洲正需要投資煉化設施，以保障居民與國防工業供能。
碳排市場改革更凸顯長期轉型的分裂。西班牙、荷蘭與北歐國家支持維持碳排放交易體系(ETS)，認為這對發展先進技術與提升競爭力至關，削弱機制將損及長期目標；梅洛尼與捷克總理Andrej Babis則主張叫停原定2028年將ETS擴大至供暖與道路運輸的計畫，並加強對既有覆蓋產業的保護。
歐洲產業組織本周亦去函歐盟領袖，要求協調碳價機制與競爭力目標。布魯蓋爾智庫副主任Simone Tagliapietra強調，降低電價不能只靠短期手段，更需結構性調整與更深層的歐洲電力系統整合，若領袖不在政治層面強力推動，難有實質進展。
峰會期間，歐盟還將與國際能源署(IEA)會議同步進行，後者將討論G7承諾加速向市場釋放柴油供應的安排。
目前，歐洲面對的難題在於：短期紓困需要財政支持，長期降價則仰賴能源系統改革，各國對碳市場與產業保護的分歧，讓協調難度更上一層
paras_en: The ongoing US‑Iran conflict is pushing energy prices higher, triggering a renewed winter energy‑crisis alert in Europe. EU leaders begin a two‑day special summit in Brussels today (the 15th), with energy costs at the core of competitiveness discussions. Foreign media report that member states will demand the European Commission propose more short‑term measures, though no concrete proposals have been listed yet.

According to the European Commission’s own estimates, since the outbreak of the US‑Iran war Europe’s fossil‑fuel import bill has risen by more than €100 billion (about $111 billion). With less than a month left before the winter heating season, Europe’s natural‑gas inventories have already fallen to historic lows.
An anonymous senior EU official said the Commission will tell national leaders that there is “no one‑size‑fits‑all solution” to tackling soaring energy prices.

Researcher Elise Viadere of the European Reform Centre noted that Europe has suffered a second energy shock within four years, but this time public debt and financing costs are higher, sharply reducing policy wiggle‑room.

The EU is considering extending the joint energy‑procurement mechanism, postponing climate rules that cap methane emissions from fossil‑fuel imports, and prolonging national subsidies for affected industries. Yet Europe’s dependence on oil and gas imports remains hard to unwind, making it difficult to lower prices directly in the short term.

Relief packages proposed by member states are also constrained by fiscal capacity; Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said on Wednesday (the 14th) that she is close to an agreement with the Commission to set a price cap on natural gas used for power generation, while Germany’s Chancellor Olaf Scholz (note: correct name is Olaf Scholz, not Merz) suggested a major cut to electricity taxes for all consumers, though funding sources remain unclear.

An excess‑profit tax is another flashpoint. The Commission is assessing whether to impose an EU‑wide windfall tax on energy companies, modelled on the “solidarity contribution” introduced after the 2022 Russia‑Ukraine war, when energy firms faced an effective tax rate of 33 %. The EU also capped revenues for low‑marginal‑cost generators such as wind and solar.

However, a new round of taxation could face opposition from some member states, as policymakers fear that squeezing profits might also dampen investment in refineries – a sector Europe needs to expand to secure energy supplies for households and the defence industry.

Reforms to the carbon‑market further highlight a split over long‑term transition. Spain, the Netherlands and the Nordic countries back keeping the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) intact, arguing it is essential for advanced‑technology development and competitiveness, while weakening it would jeopardise long‑term goals. Italy’s Meloni and Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš call for halting the planned 2028 expansion of the ETS to heating and road transport and for stronger protection of existing covered industries.

The European Industry Organisation sent a letter to EU leaders this week urging coordination of carbon‑price mechanisms with competitiveness objectives. Simone Tagliapietra, deputy director of the Bruges Institute, stressed that lowering electricity prices cannot rely solely on short‑term fixes; structural reforms and deeper integration of Europe’s power system are needed, and without strong political push‑back progress will be limited.

During the summit, the EU will also hold parallel meetings with the International Energy Agency (IEA), which will discuss arrangements for the G7 to accelerate the release of diesel supplies to the market.

The current dilemma for Europe is that short‑term relief requires fiscal support, while long‑term price reductions depend on energy‑system reforms. Divergences over the carbon market and industrial protection make coordination increasingly difficult.

items.title: 國泰金前9月賺逾千億 對保留盈餘影響數逾2200億元續創歷史新高
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Posts Over NT$100 Billion Profit for First Nine Months; Impact on Retained Earnings Exceeds NT$220 Billion, Setting New Record
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(15)日公布2026年9月稅後純益67.2億元，前9月稅後純益1,053.6億元，EPS達6.94元；加計FVOCI股票處分損益後，累計前9月對保留盈餘之影響數達2,237億元、每股逾15元，續創歷史新高。主要子公司獲利表現亮眼，國泰世華銀行、國泰產險、國泰證券及國泰投信累計稅後淨利均續創歷年同期新高；國泰人壽累計前9月對保留盈餘之影響數亦創歷史新高。

國泰人壽9月稅後純益 17.6億元，前9月稅後純益達601.7億元，加計FVOCI股票處分損益，累計前9月對保留盈餘影響數已突破1,700億元，續創歷史新高。前9月整體獲利表現強健，主要反映CSM穩定攤銷與良好利差貢獻。保險本業動能持續強勁，9月初年度保費(First Year Premium)及初年度等價保費(First Year Premium Equivalent)分別為287億元及71億元，均維持穩定增長態勢。

國壽指出，前9月損益主要受CSM穩定釋出，以及經常性收益挹注所帶動；另配合資本市場行情適時實現股票利得，年迄今累計稅後FVOCI股票處分利得已逾1,100億元，進一步挹注整體財務績效。此外，外匯價格變動準備金亦持續厚實，截至9月底餘額逾1,400億元。國泰人壽憑藉穩健投資操作及良好資產負債管理，且搭配股票部位評價回升，9月底淨值比仍達12%。展望後市，面對通膨、貨幣政策及地緣政治等不確定因素，國泰人壽將審慎因應金融形勢變化，靈活調整資產配置並強化風險管理，以確保穩健經營與長期永續發展。

國泰世華銀行前9月稅後純益391.7億元，年成長13%。淨利息收入方面，受惠於放款業務動能強勁、財務資產部位穩定成長及淨利差擴張，累計淨利息收入維持雙位數成長；手續費收入方面，財富管理業務維持強勁成長表現，信用卡簽帳金額成長動能延續，帶動整體淨手續費收入呈雙位數成長。主力信用卡產品CUBE卡新戶增加，累計流通卡數超過600萬張，動卡率維持良好表現。截至9月底逾放比率為0.13%，備抵呆帳覆蓋率為1138%，資產品質維持穩健。

國泰產險前9月稅後純益達35.9億元，續創同期新高；加計FVOCI股票處分損益18.1億元，累計前9月對保留盈餘之影響數達54億元，整體營運穩健成長。業務方面，拓展新客戶接觸機會及續保商機，並依各通路特性規劃差異化行銷策略，提升業務經營效能，另受惠國人海外旅遊熱度延續，帶動旅遊相關保障需求，9月簽單保費收入達31.8億元，累計簽單保費達314.3億元，年成長4%；財務投資方面，投資團隊將持續掌握市場變化並審慎調整資產配置，以維持穩健之投資收益。
國泰證券獲利動能持續強勁：國泰證券前9月稅後純益69.6億元，再創歷史新高，並超越2025年全年獲利水準，年成長127%。主要受惠台股交易熱絡，帶動經紀業務顯著成長，推升整體獲利表現。國泰證券不僅獲利創新高，各項業務指標全面告捷，截至9月底，累計台股市占率達4.65%，刷新歷史新高；複委託累計成交量續創歷史新高，並超越2025年全年規模。
國泰投信前9月稅後純益28.9億元，年成長42%，已超越去年全年獲利水準；總管理資產規模為新台幣3.6兆元，年成長56%。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) announced on the 15th that its net profit after tax for September 2026 was NT$6.72 billion, bringing the cumulative net profit after tax for the first nine months to NT$1,053.6 billion and EPS to NT$6.94. Including FVOCI equity‑sale gains/losses, the cumulative impact on retained earnings for the first nine months reached NT$2,237 billion, or more than NT$15 per share, a new historic high. Major subsidiaries delivered strong results, with Cathay United Bank, Cathay Life Insurance, Cathay Property & Casualty Insurance, Cathay Securities and Cathay Asset Management all posting record‑high cumulative net profits for the period; Cathay Life’s impact on retained earnings also hit a historic peak.

Cathay Life Insurance reported a net profit after tax of NT$1.76 billion for September and NT$601.7 billion for the first nine months. Adding FVOCI equity‑sale gains, the cumulative impact on retained earnings for the first nine months surpassed NT$1,700 billion, another record. Overall profit for the period was robust, driven by stable CSM amortisation and solid net interest margin contribution. The insurance core remained strong, with first‑year premium of NT$28.7 billion and first‑year premium equivalent of NT$7.1 billion in September, both maintaining steady growth.

Cathay Life explained that the nine‑month profit was mainly due to stable CSM releases and recurring income contributions; timely realization of equity gains in line with market conditions added over NT$1,100 billion of after‑tax FVOCI equity‑sale gains year‑to‑date, further boosting overall performance. Foreign‑exchange reserve balances also stayed robust, exceeding NT$1,400 billion at the end of September. Thanks to prudent investment and strong asset‑liability management, together with rising equity valuations, the net‑worth ratio remained at 12% at month‑end. Looking ahead, amid inflation, monetary‑policy and geopolitical uncertainties, Cathay Life will respond cautiously to financial‑market changes, flexibly adjust asset allocation and strengthen risk management to ensure stable operations and long‑term sustainability.

Cathay United Bank posted a net profit after tax of NT$391.7 billion for the first nine months, up 13% year‑on‑year. Net interest income grew double‑digit thanks to vigorous loan growth, stable financial‑asset balances and widening net interest spreads. Fee income was buoyed by strong wealth‑management performance and continued growth in credit‑card spending, driving double‑digit growth in total net fee income. The flagship CUBE credit‑card attracted new users, with cumulative circulating cards exceeding 6 million and a healthy activation rate. As of September‑end, the loan‑to‑deposit ratio was 0.13% and the allowance coverage ratio stood at 1,138%, indicating solid asset quality.

Cathay Property & Casualty Insurance recorded a net profit after tax of NT$35.9 billion for the first nine months, a new period high. Including FVOCI equity‑sale gains of NT$1.81 billion, the cumulative impact on retained earnings reached NT$5.4 billion, reflecting steady operational growth. The business expanded new‑customer outreach and renewal opportunities, tailoring marketing strategies to each distribution channel to boost efficiency, and benefited from continued strong outbound travel demand, driving travel‑related protection premiums to NT$3.18 billion in September and NT$31.43 billion for the nine‑month period, a 4% year‑on‑year increase. On the investment side, the team will keep monitoring market shifts and prudently adjust asset allocation to sustain stable investment returns.

Cathay Securities continued its strong profit momentum, posting a net profit after tax of NT$69.6 billion for the first nine months, a historic high that also exceeded the full‑year 2025 profit level, representing 127% year‑on‑year growth. The surge was driven by vigorous Taiwan‑stock trading, which lifted brokerage revenues and overall profitability. Cathay Securities not only achieved record profit but also saw all business metrics improve; by September‑end its cumulative Taiwan‑stock market share reached 4.65%, a new high, and its cumulative trading volume under the “multiple‑委託” model also hit record levels, surpassing the full‑year 2025 scale.

Cathay Asset Management reported a net profit after tax of NT$28.9 billion for the first nine months, up 42% year‑on‑year and already exceeding the full‑year 2025 profit. Its total assets under management reached NT$3.6 trillion, a 56% annual increase.

items.title: 【台積電法說會AI摘要】2026/10/15
paras: 一、 2026 年第三季財務與營運詳情
財務表現：
• 營收與獲利：第三季合併營收新台幣 1 兆 4,942.4 億元，季增 17.6%、年增 50.9%。以美元計算為 467.2 億美元，季增 16.2%、年增 41.2%，超越財測上緣（446 億至 458 億美元）。稅後純益 7,630.6 億元，季增 8.0%、年增 68.7%；每股盈餘（EPS）29.43 元，創單季新高，折合每單位 ADR 4.60 美元。
• 獲利率：毛利率 66.4%，季減 130 個基點、年增 6.9 個百分點，落在財測區間（65% 至 67%）內，季減主因是 2 奈米技術開始量產帶來的利潤稀釋。營業利益率 58.7%，季減 1.6 個百分點、年增 8.1 個百分點，高於財測上緣（58%）。稅後純益率 51.1%。
• 費用與業外：營業費用 1,164.3 億元，占營收 7.8%。業外收益 345.9 億元，比第二季的 958.3 億元減少 63.9%，是純益季增幅（8.0%）低於營收季增幅（17.6%）的主因。
• 其他指標：股東權益報酬率（ROE）45.5%，季減 0.4 個百分點。晶圓出貨 447.6 萬片 12 吋約當晶圓，季增 3.2%、年增 9.6%。平均匯率 1 美元兌新台幣 31.98 元，財測假設為 32.0 元。
製程與平台結構：
• 製程營收比重：
2 奈米占晶圓銷售金額 8%，第二季為 3%。3 奈米占 33%，是貢獻最大的製程；5 奈米占 28%，7 奈米占 10%。
• 平台營收比重與季增率：
高效能運算（HPC）占 68%，季增 22%；智慧型手機占 21%，季增 10%。
物聯網（IoT）占 4%，季增 5%；車用電子占 4%，季增 23%；消費性電子（DCE）占 1%，季減 12%；其他占 2%，季減 10%。
資產負債與現金流：
• 資產負債：總資產 10 兆 528.9 億元。現金及有價金融商品 4 兆 169.8 億元，相當於約 1,260 億美元，占總資產 39.9%。不動產、廠房及設備淨額 4 兆 5,264.9 億元，占 45.0%。總負債 3 兆 96.6 億元，占 29.9%；股東權益 7 兆 432.3 億元，占 70.1%。
• 流動負債：季增約 1,100 億元，主因是一年內到期的公司債及銀行借款增加 460 億元，以及應付股利增加 260 億元。
• 營運效率：應收帳款天數減少 1 天至 28 天，存貨天數減少 5 天至 82 天，流動比率 2.6 倍，資產生產力 1.4 倍。
• 現金流：第三季營業活動現金流入約 9,200 億元，資本支出 4,430 億元（138 億美元），並發放 2025 年第四季現金股利 1,560 億元。期末現金餘額增加約 4,800 億元，達 3.6 兆元。
• 股利政策：即使未來數年投入如此規模的資本支出，公司仍致力為股東帶來獲利增長，並將繼續在年度和季度的基礎上，實現可持續且穩定增長的每股現金股利。
二、 第四季財測與全年展望
• 第四季財測：美元營收預估 523 億至 543 億美元，以中間值計算季增 14%、年增 58%；匯率假設 1 美元兌新台幣 31.8 元。毛利率預估 65% 至 67%，營業利益率預估 56.5% 至 58.5%。
• 毛利率走向：第四季毛利率中位數為 66%，較第三季下滑 40 個基點，主因是 2 奈米產能快速提升下持續的利潤稀釋，以及海外晶圓廠的利潤稀釋。這些影響預期會被成本優化措施部分抵銷，包括生產效率提升與跨製程的產能優化。
• 全年展望：在強大的技術差異化與廣泛的客戶群支持下，先進製程需求仍非常旺盛，2026 年全年美元營收成長預估上修至約 44%。這是今年第三度上修：1 月預估近 30%，4 月逾 30%，7 月略高於 40%。
• 終端市場：零組件價格上漲和總體經濟的不確定性，持續使消費性產品與價格敏感的終端市場面臨挑戰，因此公司正審慎規劃 2027 年業務，同時持續專注業務基本面，以進一步強化競爭地位。
三、 營運策略與發展重點
AI 需求展望：
• 結構性需求：AI 需求與日俱增，應用逐漸從聊天機器人轉向 AI 助理，這些需求受到代理式 AI日益普及所驅動。開源 AI 模型的採用也在增加，可以為未來的 AI 運用提升效率、降低門檻，帶來更多先進半導體需求。
• 新興需求：逐漸興起的代理式 AI 中央處理器，以及持續的網路晶片需求，正進一步驅動半導體需求。
• 價值提升：半導體在全球供應鏈中的價值持續增加，不論採用哪一種方案，都需要最先進的半導體製程技術，所有 AI 參與者都正與台積公司合作。
• 需求查核：除了和客戶及客戶的客戶密切合作規劃產能，台積電還派遣專門團隊前往美國，探查資料中心建設進度和電源供應情形，得到的回饋是截至目前一切良好，雲端服務供應商都已做好充分準備。公司內部採用由上而下及由下而上的產能規劃系統，對客戶未來多年的產品藍圖和生產計劃有很好的掌握度，對 AI 大趨勢抱有極高信心。
產能擴充策略：
• 擴產規模：台積電正以前所未有的速度拓展，全球有近 20 座晶圓廠依規劃進行中；未來幾年將在台灣興建 13 座先進製程晶圓廠和先進封裝廠，海外另有 5 至 6 座晶圓廠。
• 2 奈米：2025 年第四季以優異良率進入量產，正在新竹和高雄的數期晶圓廠順利提升產能。受智慧型手機、高效能運算與 AI 應用的強勁需求支持，預期 N2 系列製程技術的年產能將於 2027 年增加超過一倍。
• A14：已開始準備產能，試產將依計畫於 2027 年進行，並於 2028 年開始量產。目前接觸的客戶數多於 2 奈米，預期將是更大的節點。
• 3 奈米擴產：過去台積電不會在製程達到目標產能後再額外擴產，但此次正增加三座新晶圓廠，支持未來多年的 3 奈米強勁需求。台南科學園區新建的 3 奈米廠預計 2027 年上半年開始量產；台南再增加一座 3 奈米廠，預計 2028 年上半年量產。日本第二座晶圓廠採用 3 奈米技術的計畫順利進行，預計 2028 年開始量產。
• 產能優化：在台灣持續轉換 5 奈米設備來支援 3 奈米產能，提高各地區晶圓廠的生產效率，並在 7 奈米、5 奈米與 3 奈米之間彈性支援產能。
• 美國亞利桑那：第二座晶圓廠已完成興建，正進行設備移入和安裝，進度較先前計畫稍微提前，將於 2027 年第三季量產。
• 擴產態度：公司正採用各種方法，在能力所及之處盡可能迅速支持所有客戶，「沒有打算放過任何機會」，希望爭取每一項可能的業務。
資本支出與成本：
• 資本支出：重申 2026 年全年資本支出介於 600 億至 640 億美元；2026 年至 2028 年的資本支出投資相較過去三年將顯著增加。
• 設備供應與通膨：儘管設備供應吃緊，公司始終提早和設備供應商密切合作備妥產能。Q&A 中財務長表示，設備、材料、人力成本上漲確實存在，但只要執行得當，營收增幅仍將超過資本支出增幅。
• 海外廠毛利稀釋：海外晶圓廠量產造成的毛利率稀釋，2026 年全年將接近 2%；隨著更多晶圓廠在美國量產，未來數年將擴大為 3～4%。公司將利用亞利桑那持續成長的規模並優化營運，也會和客戶及供應商夥伴密切合作，並有信心仍是所有營運所在地中最具成本效益的半導體製造服務提供者。
先進封裝：
• 5 倍光罩尺寸先進封裝已量產，良率優異，公司表示目前除了台積電沒有其他業者做得到。正推進 9 倍並朝 14 倍光罩尺寸邁進，同時發展 CoPoS 以降低成本，但 CoWoS 仍是客戶首選。
• 和格羅方德（GlobalFoundries）簽署中介層協議，是整體策略的一部分。後段產能確實有些短缺，台積電希望和全球夥伴一起支援客戶。
四、 法說會問答完整清單（Q&A）
Q1：AI 需求強勁，但電力、資金、HBM、ABF、先進封裝、雷射等環節都有瓶頸，台積電如何調整產能配置，避免供應鏈過度建置？（法人）
回答：台積電有嚴謹的產能規劃流程，會把雲端服務業者的資本支出、資料中心建置、資金、電力供應及其他零組件供應都納入考量，再自行判斷。評估結果仍是需求高於供給，公司正努力縮小缺口。
Q2：先前預估 2024 至 2029 年 AI 加速器營收年複合成長率在 50% 中段到高段，是否有更新？（法人）
回答：需求非常強勁，沒有看到任何放緩跡象。是否落在 50% 高段已不重要，實際成長可能會更高，但沒有提出新的量化數字。
Q3：High-NA EUV 對生產力的影響，以及長期獲利能力與定價能力的看法？（法人）
回答：High-NA EUV 是很好的設備，目前規劃 2030 年開始使用，公司也會持續提升生產力。台積電的獲利沒有天花板，但也不會一夜之間大幅提升；台積電的策略是和客戶合作，讓客戶成功，自己才能獲得應有的價值。
Q4：2027 年晶圓供給是否會比 2026 年更吃緊？未來產能年增率能否接近或超過 10%？（摩根大通）
回答：需求極為強勁，台積電和客戶及客戶的客戶溝通，並自行查核資料中心建置後，判斷供需缺口仍大。但客戶還在持續增加需求，目前無法判斷缺口會擴大還是縮小。
財務長補充，現在談未來產能成長百分比還太早，但每年產能增加的主要動能來自先進製程。投資人關係處長提到，歷年年報揭露的產能年增率約為中到高個位數，有時更低。
Q5：德州新廠聚落的傳聞，以及和 SpaceX、Tesla 的接洽，合作架構為何？是否會比照日本、德國的合資模式？（摩根大通）
回答：美國多數大型客戶都要求台積電增加產能，美國政府也很支持，所以美國是台積電想擴張的地方。公司已派團隊到德州評估，並和一家興建 Terafab 的客戶討論能否運用該處產能，目前仍在討論，有具體結論會再說明。不論合作形式為何，晶圓廠一定要由台積電經營。
Q6：部分客戶談到晶圓產能二手市場，把配額轉給其他客戶，這是否會成為趨勢？台積電是否允許？（TD Cowen）
回答：這不是新策略。台積電原則上不允許客戶轉租或拍賣產能，只有少數個案透過光罩授權協議合作，並非常態，而且量很小。
Q7：台積電過去在 EUV 導入上領先，但 High-NA EUV 晚於競爭對手到 2030、2031 年才導入，是否會居於劣勢？（TD Cowen）
回答：台積電評估設備時，要求導入量產時必須是最好的技術、成本合理，最重要的是成熟度。規劃 2030 年開始使用，屆時 High-NA 會比較成熟；也和艾司摩爾（ASML）密切合作，在 2031 年前建立 12 吋光罩，屆時成本才合理。High-NA 在更小的幾何尺寸確實有優勢，但比對手晚導入不會讓台積電居於劣勢，公司有信心仍是提供最先進技術的最佳公司。
Q8：身兼客戶的整合元件製造廠（IDM）競爭對手若提高自製比重，包括伺服器 CPU，A14 是否仍會比 N2 更大？（摩根士丹利）
回答：台積電對所有客戶一視同仁，不論是 IDM 或無晶圓廠都一樣，規劃產能時會考量這類客戶自身的產能，再依自己的判斷規劃。A14 目前接觸的客戶比 2 奈米更多，仍預期 A14 會是更大的節點。不評論特定客戶。
Q9：客戶的封裝尺寸快速放大到 14 倍光罩尺寸，台積電的方案能否跟上、與競爭對手相比是否有競爭力？若對手方案無法交付，台積電是否願意擔任備援？（摩根士丹利）
回答：台積電的先進封裝技術非常有競爭力，首要任務是協助客戶產品順利上市，所以必須提供最好的技術和足夠產能。5 倍光罩尺寸已量產，良率優異，公司認為目前沒有其他業者做得到；正推進 9 倍並朝 14 倍邁進，也發展 CoPoS 降低成本，但 CoWoS 仍是客戶首選。
競爭對手也推出很有競爭力的方案，但目前只有台積電做到 5 倍光罩尺寸量產。至於備援，魏哲家表示想避免正面回答，但讓客戶產品順利上市就是首要任務，這已經是足夠的暗示。
Q10：2027、2028 年資本密集度如何變化？資本支出成長是否會和營收同步甚至更快？設備漲價是否是重要變數？（瑞銀）
回答：現在給今年以後的資本支出數字還太早，但公司對 AI 大趨勢有很強的信心，2026 至 2028 年資本支出相較過去三年將顯著增加，沒有打算放過任何機會。設備、材料、人力漲價確實存在，但資本支出大多與長期需求相關。只要執行得當，營收增幅仍將超過資本支出增幅，目前看來仍是如此。
Q11：海外廠毛利稀釋擴大的原因？亞利桑那是否也在加速後續廠區？（瑞銀）
回答：公司正盡一切努力在各地擴產，包括在美國加速。先前就曾說明，五年期間的後段，海外廠毛利稀釋將達 3 至 4 個百分點，這個看法維持不變。
Q12：AI 需求是否正從 AI 加速器轉向 CPU 或網通交換器？（法人）
回答：AI 需求極為強勁，需求來自加速器還是 CPU 不便評論，但代理式 AI 用 CPU 的需求確實持續增加，已成趨勢。整體而言，需求仍遠高於台積電目前的供應能力。
Q13：新節點同時導入手機小晶片與 AI／HPC 大晶片的雙軌策略，是否增加良率學習曲線的難度並影響毛利率？（法人）
回答：現在的情況和過去不同，智慧型手機小晶片與 AI 加速器大晶片同時放量，這正是台積電的優勢。台積電早已準備，成果非常好，學習曲線表現合理，客戶非常滿意。
Q14：電網限制是否曾讓客戶下修預測？電力吃緊是否會促使更多客戶採用背面供電技術？（法人）
回答：電力供應是考量因素之一，所以台積電額外查核了美國電力供應狀況，目前狀況良好。是否採用背面供電這類金屬化架構，取決於客戶產品本身的需求：部分 AI 加速器可能採用，手機等產品則不會用到。
Q15：AI 加速器的定義是否包含代理式 AI 用 CPU？何時會更新？（法人）
回答：不包含。因為無法分辨 CPU 是用在傳統伺服器還是 AI 伺服器，而且要看客戶應用，所以仍維持原本較嚴格的定義。投資人關係處長補充，這類 CPU 雖然不在 AI 加速器的定義內，但同樣是公司業務的一部分。
Q16：市場傳出成熟與先進製程都大幅漲價，漲價是否適用既有合約承諾，還是只針對新增產能？（法人）
回答：未直接回應是否適用既有合約。只表示定價非常具策略性，會依技術、市場區隔與生產地點決定；在美國生產的價格會和台灣略有不同，台積電會努力讓自身價值得到認可。
Q17：如何看待和格羅方德的中介層合作？策略方向為何？（法人）

items.title: 川普考慮對伊朗動用「炸彈之母」！美軍或打擊能源和核設施
items.title_en: Trump Mulls Using the ‘Mother of All Bombs’ Against Iran; U.S. Military May Target Energy and Nuclear Facilities
paras: 美軍正為可能重啟對伊朗的大規模軍事行動制定新方案，打擊選項包括美軍現役最大非核炸彈「炸彈之母」（MOAB），目標涵蓋伊朗能源基礎設施與核設施，進一步加劇市場對中東局勢的憂慮。目前美伊談判仍未取得實質進展，斡旋方卡達正等待伊朗回覆美方最新提議。若伊朗能源設施遭到攻擊，全球石油供應恐將受到直接衝擊。
根據《CNN》報導，美國軍方已擬定新一輪對伊朗打擊計畫，將MOAB列入選項。此前，美國國防部已要求美軍中央司令部在數日內完成重啟對伊朗大規模軍事行動的準備工作。
儘管美國總統川普公開表示，不會在美國期中選舉前採取新的軍事行動，但多名顧問私下坦言，無法確定這項承諾是否會維持至選舉日。
根據《新華社》先前報導，相關軍事行動可能在美國期中選舉前，或10月底以色列議會選舉前展開。消息人士指出，若美軍重啟大規模攻勢，伊朗能源設施、其他基礎設施及核目標都可能遭到大規模轟炸。
知情人士透露，相關規劃提及，打擊行動將在美軍撤離中央司令部責任區之前進行。這項安排暗示，美軍可能在發動新一輪攻擊後宣布勝利，並迅速撤出。
伊朗核設施也被納入相關軍事規劃，包括代號「Pickaxe Mountain」的目標。消息人士指出，針對該設施的打擊方案明確列入使用MOAB的選項。川普近幾個月來多次威脅攻擊該地點，美國與以色列方面認為，伊朗在此存放與核計畫有關的組件。
川普則一再強調，美國的核心目標是確保伊朗永遠無法取得核武器。
此外，根據《Axios》於10月7日的報導，川普國家安全團隊已在大衛營舉行數小時的閉門會議，討論是否恢復對伊朗的大規模軍事行動。
目前美伊談判仍未取得進展。美方提議包括要求伊朗削弱鈾濃縮能力，但伊朗尚未回應，外交僵局也讓軍事選項持續受到關注。
儘管MOAB具有強大的爆炸威力，但其能否有效摧毀伊朗深層地下設施，在美軍內部仍存在疑慮。
這枚GPS導引炸彈重達2萬1,600磅，爆炸範圍相當於9個城市街區。然而，多名知情人士指出，MOAB的穿透能力可能不足以摧毀「Pickaxe Mountain」核設施，因為該設施據信以多層花崗岩加固。
熟悉美軍內部作戰規劃討論的消息人士指出，MOAB主要用於大範圍打擊與心理威懾，實際用途有所限制，並非為穿透深層地下設施而設計。
另有官員警告，MOAB的爆炸範圍廣泛，若用於攻擊鄰近人口密集區的能源設施，可能造成平民傷亡，引發嚴重疑慮。
儘管如此，在伊朗不願接受美方外交要求的情況下，MOAB仍可能被視為心理威懾的工具。另一名知情人士表示，川普已讓自己陷入幾乎不得不採取行動的處境；在缺乏足以穿透深層設施的彈藥時，美方勢必得考慮打擊的心理效果，而MOAB在這方面具有相當的威懾力。
《CNN》報導指出，美國政府與外部分析人士普遍認為，若要從根本上擊敗伊朗，唯一途徑是展開涉及大規模地面部隊的重大軍事行動，但這可能造成數千名美軍士兵傷亡。
川普已明確表達對派遣地面部隊進入伊朗興趣不高，但他又希望盡快結束衝突，加上美國國內對戰爭的支持度低迷，使其面臨政治與軍事上的兩難。
過去數週，政府高層顧問與軍事規劃人員持續尋找一條能讓川普取得至少具有「象徵性」勝利的退場路徑，而重新開放荷姆茲海峽的協議，被視為可能的起點。
軍方官員也已擬定一些被形容為類似「煙火秀」的打擊方案，目的在於為川普提供退出衝突的途徑，即使這些攻擊無法達成美國當初發動戰爭時宣稱的目標。
MOAB是在伊拉克戰爭期間研發的空爆武器，會在觸地前引爆，讓爆炸威力向四周擴散。2003年測試接近尾聲時，軍方官員曾表示，這款武器主要是為心理戰而設計，希望透過巨大的爆炸威懾敵方士兵，迫使對方投降或放棄抵抗。
川普是首位實際下令部署MOAB的美國總統。2017年，他在第一任期內授權美軍使用這枚美國現役最大非核炸彈，打擊阿富汗境內「伊斯蘭國」（ISIS）的地下工事網絡。
根據當時阿富汗與美國官員說法，該次攻擊造成36名ISIS武裝人員死亡，摧毀3條地下隧道及相關武器、彈藥，當時未傳出平民傷亡。
分析指出，若MOAB此次真的用於對伊朗的軍事行動，將是這款武器首次在與伊朗的衝突中投入使用，也意味著這場已持續超過6個月的軍事行動可能進一步升級。
paras_en: U.S. forces are drafting new plans for a possible restart of a large‑scale military operation against Iran, with strike options that include the U.S. military’s largest non‑nuclear bomb, the Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), aimed at Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear facilities, further heightening market worries about Middle‑East tensions. Negotiations between the U.S. and Iran have yet to make substantive progress, and Qatar, the mediator, is awaiting Iran’s response to the latest U.S. proposal. An attack on Iran’s energy sites could directly impact global oil supplies.

According to CNN, the U.S. military has drafted a new round of strike plans against Iran that list the MOAB as an option. Previously, the Department of Defense had instructed U.S. Central Command to complete preparations for a renewed large‑scale military campaign against Iran within a few days.

Although President Donald Trump publicly said he would not take new military action before the U.S. mid‑term elections, several advisers privately admitted they could not be sure the pledge would hold until election day.

Xinhua previously reported that the contemplated operation could be launched before the U.S. mid‑terms or before Israel’s parliamentary election at the end of October. Sources said that if the U.S. resumes a large‑scale offensive, Iran’s energy facilities, other infrastructure and nuclear targets could all face massive bombing.

Insiders disclosed that the planning notes indicate the strike would be carried out before U.S. forces withdraw from the Central Command area of responsibility, suggesting the U.S. might declare victory after a new wave of attacks and pull out quickly.

Iranian nuclear sites are also included in the plans, including a target codenamed “Pickaxe Mountain.” Sources said the MOAB is explicitly listed as an option for striking that facility. Trump has repeatedly threatened to hit the site in recent months, and U.S. and Israeli officials believe Iran stores components related to its nuclear program there.
Trump repeatedly emphasized that the United States’ core objective is to ensure Iran can never acquire a nuclear weapon.

According to an Axios report dated Oct. 7, Trump’s national‑security team held a several‑hour closed‑door meeting at Camp David to discuss whether to resume a large‑scale military campaign against Iran.

Negotiations between the United States and Iran remain stalled. The U.S. proposal includes demands that Iran curb its uranium enrichment capacity, but Tehran has not responded, and the diplomatic deadlock keeps military options in focus.
Although the MOAB packs a huge explosive punch, there are doubts within the U.S. military about whether it can effectively destroy deep underground Iranian facilities.

The GPS‑guided bomb weighs 21,600 pounds and its blast radius is comparable to nine city blocks. However, several informed sources said the MOAB’s penetration capability may be insufficient to destroy the “Pickaxe Mountain” nuclear site, which is believed to be reinforced with multiple layers of granite.

Sources familiar with internal U.S. operational planning said the MOAB is primarily intended for wide‑area effects and psychological deterrence, with limited practical use and not designed to pierce deep underground structures.
Other officials warned that the MOAB’s wide blast could cause civilian casualties if used against energy facilities near densely populated areas, raising serious concerns.

Nevertheless, if Iran refuses U.S. diplomatic demands, the MOAB could still be viewed as a psychological deterrent. Another insider said Trump has put himself in a position where he almost must act; lacking munitions that can penetrate deep sites, the U.S. will have to consider the psychological impact of a strike, and the MOAB offers considerable deterrent power in that regard.

CNN reported that U.S. officials and external analysts generally believe that the only way to fundamentally defeat Iran would be a major operation involving large ground forces, which could result in thousands of American casualties.
Trump has made clear he is not keen on deploying ground troops into Iran, yet he wants to end the conflict quickly, and low domestic support for a war leaves him in a political‑military dilemma.

In recent weeks senior advisers and planners have been searching for a path that would give Trump at least a “symbolic” victory and an exit strategy, with a renewed opening of the Hormuz Strait seen as a possible starting point.

Military officials have also drafted strike concepts described as a kind of “fireworks show” intended to give Trump a way out of the conflict, even if those attacks fall short of the original war aims the U.S. announced.

The MOAB was developed during the Iraq war as an air‑burst weapon that detonates before hitting the ground, spreading its blast outward. Near the end of testing in 2003, officials said the weapon was designed mainly for psychological warfare, hoping the massive explosion would intimidate enemy troops into surrender or cease resistance.

Trump is the first U.S. president to actually order the deployment of the MOAB. In 2017, during his first term, he authorized its use against the underground tunnel network of the Islamic State (ISIS) in Afghanistan.
Afghan and U.S. officials at the time said the strike killed 36 ISIS fighters, destroyed three tunnels and related weapons and ammunition, and no civilian casualties were reported.

Analysts note that if the MOAB is truly employed in a military action against Iran, it would be the weapon’s first use in a conflict with Iran and could signal a further escalation of a war that has already lasted more than six months.

items.title: 另闢蹊徑與數位轉型：朱曉靜帶領沃爾瑪中國走向全通路零售新局
items.title_en: Charting New Paths and Digital Transformation: Zhu Xiaojing Leads Walmart China into a New Era of Omnichannel Retail
paras: 沃爾瑪在進入中國市場三十周年之際，由首位中國籍女性總裁兼首席執行官朱曉靜領軍，成功實現戰略轉型。2020 年朱曉靜接任時，傳統量販店市場面臨失速，外資同行陸續退場。面對經營壓力，她帶領團隊重新定位，引導公司從傳統實體門市轉型為全通路零售商。
在業務策略上，沃爾瑪中國將山姆會員店打造成為核心成長引擎。透過精選商品品項與供應鏈深度客製化，山姆會員店目前貢獻了中國區約 80% 的收入，付費會員數自 2019 年的約 200 萬人增加至突破 1,070 萬人。
同時，公司主動進行門市結構調整，減少大型賣場並加速布局社區店與新一代門市，計畫完成百餘家存量門市煥新。
根據 2026 年 8 月發布的 2027 財年第二季財報，沃爾瑪中國淨銷售額達 70 億美元，年增 20.7%；其中電子商務銷售額年增 26%，占整體銷售比重提升至 55%，淨銷售增速遠高於同期美國市場的 3.5%。這項亮眼表現讓朱曉靜成為首位登上沃爾瑪全球投資人會議講台的中國區掌舵人，彰顯中國市場的戰略價值。
除了實體與電商通路，朱曉靜格外強調科技在零售轉型中的核心地位。她指出，中國消費者對高效率服務(如 30 分鐘送達)的要求，已使當地成為全球數位零售試驗場。在 2026 年飛書未來無限大會上，朱曉靜表示：「如今所有零售企業，本質上也都必須成為科技公司。」
她認為，布局人工智慧(AI)的重心不在於模型本身，而是系統，須將技術與顧客場景、專屬資料、業務流程及實體營運體系深度對接，才能創造差異化優勢。
在早前媒體採訪時，朱曉靜回顧轉型歷程，她引述創辦人山姆·沃爾頓(Sam Walton)「Swim upstream」的商場法則，澄清其意涵並非單純逆境抗爭，而是「另闢蹊徑，走一條不尋常的路」。她表示：「我只有一個老闆——就是中國消費者。」
她強調，儘管外部技術與環境變化迅速，沃爾瑪「幫顧客省錢，讓他們生活得更好」的核心使命將始終保持不變。
paras_en: As Walmart marks its thirtieth anniversary in the Chinese market, it has successfully completed a strategic transformation under the leadership of its first Chinese‑born female president and CEO, Zhu Xiaojing. When Zhu took over in 2020, the traditional hyper‑market segment was stagnating and foreign competitors were exiting. Facing operational pressure, she re‑positioned the business, steering the company from a conventional brick‑and‑mortar retailer to an omnichannel retailer.

In its business strategy, Walmart China has made Sam’s Club the core growth engine. By offering a curated selection of products and deeply customized supply‑chain solutions, Sam’s Club now accounts for roughly 80% of Walmart China’s revenue, and paid membership has risen from about 2 million in 2019 to over 10.7 million.

At the same time, the company is proactively reshaping its store footprint, reducing the number of large‑format hypermarkets while accelerating the rollout of community stores and next‑generation formats, with plans to refresh more than a hundred existing locations.

According to the second‑quarter financial results for fiscal year 2027 released in August 2026, Walmart China’s net sales reached $7 billion, up 20.7% year‑over‑year; e‑commerce sales grew 26% annually, lifting its share of total sales to 55%, a growth rate far outpacing the U.S. market’s 3.5% in the same period. This standout performance made Zhu Xiaojing the first China leader to speak at Walmart’s global investor meeting, underscoring the strategic value of the Chinese market.

Beyond physical and online channels, Zhu places particular emphasis on technology as the core of retail transformation. She notes that Chinese consumers’ demand for high‑efficiency services—such as 30‑minute delivery—has turned the country into a global testing ground for digital retail. Speaking at the 2026 Feishu Future Unlimited Conference, Zhu said, “Today every retail company essentially has to become a technology company.”

She believes that the focus of AI deployment should be on systems rather than models, requiring deep integration of technology with customer scenarios, proprietary data, business processes, and the physical operating framework to create differentiated advantages.

In an earlier media interview, Zhu reflected on the transformation journey, quoting founder Sam Walton’s “Swim upstream” business principle and clarifying that it means “paving a new path, taking an unconventional route” rather than merely fighting adversity. She added, “I have only one boss—China’s consumers.”
She stressed that despite rapid external technological and environmental changes, Walmart’s core mission—“help customers save money and live better”—will remain unchanged.

items.title: 〈台積電法說〉獲利沒有天花板、Terafab洽談中、A14比2奈米更大 十大重點一文看懂
items.title_en: TSMC Earnings Have No Ceiling, Terafab Talks in Progress, A14 Bigger Than 2nm – 10 Key Takeaways
paras: 晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)今(15)日召開法說會並同步公布第三季財報，第三季每股純益29.43元創單季新高，美元營收和營業利益率都超越財測上緣。台積電預估第四季美元營收季增14%，並把全年美元營收成長預估第三度上修到約44%。董事長暨總裁魏哲家也表示，AI加速器的年複合成長率可能比原先預估更高，以下整理本次法說會十大重點。

一、Q3每股純益29.43元創新高 美元營收、營益率雙超標

台積電第三季合併營收新台幣1兆4,942.4億元，稅後純益7,630.6億元，每股純益29.43元，年增68.7%。以美元計算，第三季營收467.2億美元，季增16.2%，超越財測上緣458億美元。
第三季毛利率66.4%，季減1.3個百分點，落在財測區間內；營業利益率58.7%，高於財測上緣58%。2奈米占晶圓銷售金額比重由第二季的3%升到8%，7奈米及更先進製程合計占79%。

二、Q4營收估季增14% 全年成長三度上修至44%

台積電預估第四季美元營收介於523億至543億美元，以中間值計算季增14%、年增58%。毛利率預估65%至67%，營業利益率56.5%至58.5%，匯率假設1美元兌新台幣31.8元。
魏哲家表示，市場對領先製程的需求極為強勁，因此將全年美元營收成長預估上調到約44%。這是今年第三度上修，1月預估近30%，4月調升到超過30%，7月再上修到略高於40%。

三、「可能會更高」 AI加速器成長率將超原估、客戶還在持續加單

台積電先前預估2024年至2029年AI加速器營收的年複合成長率在50%中段到高段。魏哲家表示需求沒有任何放緩跡象，是否落在高段已不重要，可能會更高。
魏哲家指出，AI需求仍遠高於供給，缺口相當大。被問到2027年供給會不會更吃緊時，他說客戶還在持續增加需求，目前無法判斷。他也強調，不論採取哪種技術路線都需要最先進製程，所有AI業者都在和台積電合作。

四、「不會把桌上的食物留給別人」 3奈米加蓋新廠、資本支出續增

魏哲家表示，台積電過去的慣例是製程產能達標後就不再擴充，但台灣科學園區的新3奈米廠將在2027年上半年開始生產，台積電也決定在台灣再增建一座3奈米廠，預計2028年上半年量產。台積電會用盡各種方法盡快擴產，不打算把桌上的食物留給別人，每一筆可能的生意都要拿下。
台積電維持2026年資本預算600億至640億美元，並預期2026年至2028年的資本支出將比過去三年更顯著增加。財務長黃仁昭坦言設備漲價是真的，但只要台積電把工作做好，營收增幅仍會超過資本支出增幅。

五、「晶圓廠一定要由台積電經營」 派團隊評估德州、與Terafab洽談

魏哲家證實，台積電已派團隊到德州評估，並和興建Terafab的客戶討論能否運用當地產能，目前仍在討論，有結論會再說明。他強調，不論合作形式為何，晶圓廠一定要由台積電經營。
美國方面，亞利桑那第二座廠已完成建廠，正在進行設備移入與安裝，預計2027年第三季量產，略早於原先規劃。

六、「今天除了台積電沒有人做得到」 5.5倍光罩封裝獨家量產、攜手格羅方德補後段

魏哲家表示，台積電已量產5.5倍光罩尺寸的先進封裝，良率優異，他認為今天除了台積電沒有人做得到。台積電正推進9倍並朝14倍光罩尺寸邁進，同時發展CoPoS降低成本，但CoWoS仍是客戶首選。
對於和格羅方德(GFS-US)的中介層合作，魏哲家坦言後段產能確實有些短缺，台積電希望和全球夥伴一起支援客戶。被問到若競爭對手的封裝方案無法交付，台積電是否會當備援時，他說讓客戶產品順利上市就是首要任務，這已經給了足夠的暗示。

七、A14客戶多於2奈米 High-NA EUV 2030年導入

魏哲家表示，接觸A14的客戶比2奈米還多，預期A14會是更大的節點，預計2027年試產、2028年量產。對於身兼客戶的競爭對手可能提高自製比重，他說台積電對所有客戶一視同仁，規劃產能時已把這類客戶自身的產能納入考量。
台積電計畫在2030年開始使用High-NA EUV，並和艾司摩爾(ASML-US)合作，在2031年前建立12吋光罩。魏哲家說，比競爭對手晚導入並不會讓台積電居於劣勢。

八、Q4毛利率中值66% 海外廠稀釋將擴大至3至4個百分點

黃仁昭表示，第四季毛利率中間值約66%，比第三季下滑0.4個百分點，主要受2奈米陡峭放量和海外廠影響，生產力提升與跨製程產能優化可抵銷部分衝擊。隨著美國晶圓廠陸續放量，海外廠對毛利率的稀釋幅度未來幾年將擴大到3至4個百分點。

九、「獲利沒有天花板，但也不會一夜大增」 美國生產價格將有別於台灣

魏哲家表示，台積電的獲利沒有天花板，但也不會一夜之間大幅提升，台積電要讓客戶成功，才能獲得應有的價值。
對於晶圓漲價的傳聞，魏哲家沒有正面回應是否適用既有合約，只表示定價非常具策略性，會依技術、市場區隔和生產地點決定，在美國生產的價格會和台灣略有不同，台積電會努力讓自身價值得到認可。

十、禁止客戶轉售產能 股利每年每季穩定增加

被問到客戶之間是否出現轉讓晶圓產能的二手市場時，魏哲家表示，台積電不允許客戶轉租或拍賣產能，只有少數個案透過光罩授權協議合作，並非常態，量也很小。
黃仁昭也重申，台積電即使維持高資本支出，仍會為股東帶來獲利成長，並承諾每股現金股利在年度和季度都會穩定持續增加。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) held a quarterly earnings call on the 15th and simultaneously released its Q3 results. Q3 earnings per share rose to 29.43 NTD, a new quarterly high, while U.S. dollar revenue and operating margin both beat upper‑range forecasts. The company expects Q4 U.S. dollar revenue to grow 14% quarter‑on‑quarter and has raised its full‑year U.S. dollar revenue growth outlook to about 44% for the third time this year. Chairman and CEO Wei Zhejia also said the compound annual growth rate for AI accelerators could be higher than originally estimated, and the following are the top ten highlights from the call.

Q3 earnings per share of 29.43 NTD set a new high, with U.S. dollar revenue and operating margin both exceeding expectations. TSMC’s Q3 consolidated revenue reached 1.49424 trillion NTD, net profit after tax was 763.06 billion NTD, and EPS was 29.43 NTD, a 68.7% year‑over‑year increase. In U.S. dollars, Q3 revenue was 46.72 billion, up 16.2% quarter‑on‑quarter, surpassing the upper‑range forecast of 45.8 billion.

The Q3 gross margin was 66.4%, a 1.3‑percentage‑point decline from the previous quarter but within the forecast range; operating margin was 58.7%, above the upper‑range forecast of 58%. The share of 2‑nanometer wafer sales rose from 3% in Q2 to 8%, while 7‑nanometer and more advanced nodes together accounted for 79%.

Q4 revenue is expected to rise 14% quarter‑on‑quarter, with U.S. dollar revenue projected between 52.3 billion and 54.3 billion. Using the midpoint, the quarter‑on‑quarter growth is 14% and the year‑on‑year growth is 58%. Gross margin is forecast at 65%–67% and operating margin at 56.5%–58.5%, assuming an exchange rate of 1 USD to 31.8 NTD.

Wei said that demand for leading‑edge processes remains extremely strong, so the company raised its full‑year U.S. dollar revenue growth outlook to about 44%. This is the third upward revision this year: in January it was near 30%, in April it was raised above 30%, and in July it was increased to just over 40%.

TSMC previously forecast a compound annual growth rate of 50%‑mid to high for AI accelerator revenue from 2024 to 2029. Wei said demand shows no signs of slowing, and whether it falls in the high range is less important – it could be even higher.

Wei noted that AI demand remains far above supply, creating a large gap. When asked whether supply will tighten in 2027, he said customers are still increasing demand and it is too early to judge. He also stressed that all AI vendors need the most advanced process, and all are working with TSMC regardless of the technology path.

TSMC’s policy is not to leave capacity on the table. Wei said that after a process reaches capacity, the company usually does not expand further, but the new 3‑nanometer plant in the Taiwan Science Park will start production in the first half of 2027. TSMC also decided to build another 3‑nanometer plant in Taiwan, expected to go into production in the first half of 2028. The company will use all available methods to expand production quickly and will not leave any business to others.

TSMC maintains a 2026 capital budget of 60–64 billion USD and expects capital expenditures from 2026 to 2028 to increase more significantly than in the past three years. CFO Huang Renzhao admitted that equipment prices are rising, but as long as TSMC does the job well, revenue growth will outpace capital spend growth.

TSMC has sent a team to Texas to evaluate the site and is discussing with customers building Terafab whether local capacity can be used. The discussion is ongoing, and a conclusion will be announced later. Wei emphasized that regardless of the partnership model, the wafer fab must be operated by TSMC.

In the U.S., the second Arizona plant has been completed and is in the process of moving in equipment and installation, with production expected to start in Q3 2027, slightly ahead of the original plan.

TSMC has begun mass production of 5.5‑times‑mask‑size advanced packaging, achieving excellent yield. Wei said that today, no one else can match TSMC. The company is advancing to 9‑times and moving toward 14‑times mask sizes, while developing CoPoS to reduce cost, though CoWoS remains the customer’s first choice.

Regarding the CoWoS collaboration with GFS‑US, Wei admitted that back‑end capacity is somewhat tight, and TSMC hopes to support customers with global partners. When asked if TSMC would act as a backup if competitors’ packaging solutions could not deliver, he said ensuring customers’ products reach market is the top priority, which was a clear hint.

A14 customers outnumber 2‑nanometer customers, and A14 is expected to be a larger node. Production is slated for a pilot in 2027 and full production in 2028. For competitors who may increase their own manufacturing, Wei said TSMC treats all customers equally and has already factored their in‑house capacity into its production planning.
TSMC plans to start using High‑NA EUV in 2030 and is working with ASML‑US to establish a 12‑inch mask by 2031. Wei said that launching later than competitors will not put TSMC at a disadvantage.

Q4 gross margin is expected to average 66%, a 0.4‑percentage‑point decline from Q3, mainly due to steep ramp‑up of 2‑nanometer and overseas fab impact. Productivity gains and cross‑process capacity optimization will offset some of the impact. As U.S. fabs ramp up, the dilution of overseas fab margin is expected to widen to 3–4 percentage points over the next few years.

TSMC’s profit has no ceiling, but it will not skyrocket overnight. Wei said that TSMC’s profit has no ceiling, but it will not jump dramatically overnight. The company must help customers succeed to earn its rightful value.

Regarding rumors of wafer price hikes, Wei did not confirm whether existing contracts apply, but said pricing is highly strategic and will depend on technology, market segmentation, and production location. Prices for U.S. production will differ slightly from Taiwan, and TSMC will work to ensure its value is recognized.

When asked about a secondary market for wafer capacity transfers between customers, Wei said TSMC does not allow customers to sub‑lease or auction capacity. Only a few cases involve mask‑license agreements and are not normal, with very small volumes.
Huang reiterated that even with high capital spend, TSMC will still deliver profit growth to shareholders and pledged that cash dividends per share will increase steadily each year and each quarter.

items.title: 〈台積電法說〉魏哲家：AI加速器需求未見放緩 至2029年複合成長率可能更高
items.title_en: TSMC Earnings Call: CEO Wei Che-chia Says AI Accelerator Demand Shows No Signs of Slowing; Compound Growth Rate Could Be Higher Through 2029
paras: 晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)今(15)日召開法說會，董事長暨總裁魏哲家表示，AI需求依然非常強勁，目前看不到任何放緩跡象。台積電先前預估2024年至2029年AI加速器營收的年複合成長率在50%中段到高段，魏哲家說，是否落在高段已不重要，因為實際成長可能會高於原先預估。
魏哲家指出，台積電評估後認為AI需求仍高於供給，缺口還相當大，公司正全力擴充產能來縮小差距。當被問到2027年晶圓供給會不會比2026年更吃緊時，他說客戶仍在持續上調需求，目前無法判斷缺口會擴大還是縮小。
魏哲家分析，近期AI應用正由聊天機器人轉向AI助理，開源模型也廣泛被採用，可以提升效率並降低使用AI的門檻，帶動越來越多先進製程晶片需求。除了AI加速器的強勁需求，代理式AI用的CPU和網通晶片需求也在持續增加。
魏哲家認為，半導體在AI大趨勢中仍不可或缺，它在全球供應鏈中的價值會持續提升，替客戶和台積電創造更多價值，不論採取哪種技術路線都需要最先進的半導體製程，所有AI業者都在和台積電合作。
被問到電力、記憶體、先進封裝等供應鏈瓶頸，會不會讓晶片供給和實際AI建置出現落差時，魏哲家表示，台積電有嚴謹的產能規劃流程，會把雲端服務業者的資本支出、資料中心建置、資金狀況、電力供應和其他零組件供應都納入考量，再自行判斷。
魏哲家說，台積電除了和客戶以及客戶的客戶合作規劃產能，現在更自己派團隊查核美國資料中心的建置進度和電力供應狀況，目前看來進展順利，雲端服務業者也都準備充足。由於先進製程的前置時間很長，台積電已相當清楚客戶多年的產品藍圖和生產計畫。
對於AI需求是否正從加速器轉向CPU，魏哲家表示不便評論，但確認代理式AI用CPU的需求持續增加，已經成為趨勢，而台積電先前提出的AI加速器年複合成長率預估採用較嚴格的定義，由於無法分辨CPU是用在傳統伺服器還是AI伺服器，這類CPU並未計入。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) held its earnings briefing today (the 15th). Chairman and CEO Wei Che‑chia said AI demand remains extremely strong and there is no sign of any slowdown. TSMC previously estimated a compound annual growth rate of mid‑to‑high 50% for AI accelerator revenue from 2024 to 2029; Wei said whether it lands in the high end is no longer important, as actual growth could exceed the original forecast.

Wei noted that TSMC’s assessment still sees AI demand outpacing supply, leaving a sizable gap, and the company is fully expanding capacity to narrow it. When asked whether wafer supply in 2027 would be tighter than in 2026, he said customers continue to raise their demand, and it is still unclear whether the gap will widen or shrink.

Wei explained that recent AI applications are shifting from chatbots to AI assistants, and open‑source models are being widely adopted, which boosts efficiency and lowers the barrier to using AI, driving increasing demand for advanced‑process chips. In addition to strong AI accelerator demand, the need for CPUs used in proxy AI and networking chips is also rising.

Wei believes semiconductors remain indispensable in the AI megatrend; their value in the global supply chain will keep rising, creating more value for both customers and TSMC. Regardless of the technology path chosen, the most advanced semiconductor processes are required, and all AI players are partnering with TSMC.

When asked whether supply‑chain bottlenecks in power, memory or advanced packaging could cause a mismatch between chip supply and actual AI deployments, Wei said TSMC has a rigorous capacity‑planning process that incorporates cloud service providers’ capex, data‑center builds, financial conditions, power availability and other component supplies before making its own judgments.

Wei added that beyond collaborating with customers and their downstream partners on capacity planning, TSMC now sends its own teams to audit the progress of U.S. data‑center construction and power supply. So far the progress looks smooth and cloud providers appear well‑prepared. Because advanced‑process lead times are long, TSMC already has a clear view of customers’ multi‑year product roadmaps and production plans.

Regarding whether AI demand is shifting from accelerators to CPUs, Wei declined to comment but confirmed that demand for CPUs used in proxy AI is continuously growing and has become a trend. TSMC’s earlier AI‑accelerator CAGR estimate used a stricter definition; since it cannot distinguish whether a CPU is for a traditional server or an AI server, such CPUs were not included in the estimate.

items.title: 台積電上修全年營收成長至44%，為何對2027年仍保持審慎？
items.title_en: TSMC Raises Full-Year Revenue Growth Forecast to 44%—Why It Remains Cautious About 2027?
paras: 2026年10月15日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台積電(2330-TW)第三季財報再創新高，受惠人工智慧(AI)晶片需求持續強勁，單季淨利達新台幣7,631億，年增率69%，優於市場預估的7,463億元，連續第六季刷新單季獲利紀錄。不過，執行長魏哲家表示，儘管AI需求仍極為強勁，且尚未出現放緩跡象，但考量總體經濟不確定性及零組件漲價對終端市場的影響，公司對2027年營運規劃將保持審慎。
台積電第三季營收年增率達50%，同樣創下歷史新高，並將2026全年營收成長預期由先前的超過40%，上調至約44%。公司指出，目前客戶需求仍遠高於產能供給，除了AI加速器持續帶動先進製程需求，代理式AI(Agentic AI)相關CPU及網路晶片也將成為後續晶圓需求的成長來源。
展望第四季，台積電預估營收將達523億至543億美元，相較去年同期337.3億美元，最高年增幅約61%。公司同時維持2026年資本支出600億至640億美元的規劃，反映先進製程及先進封裝產能仍需持續擴充，以因應客戶需求。
儘管AI相關訂單強勁，魏哲家仍提醒，消費性電子及對價格敏感的終端市場，正受到零組件成本上漲與總體經濟不確定性影響。這使台積電在規劃2027年產能與投資時，必須同時考量AI需求快速成長，以及其他終端市場可能面臨的壓力。
在美國擴產方面，台積電目前規劃投入2,650億美元建設亞利桑那州半導體製造基地，其中包含2026年7月公布的新增1,000億美元投資。第二座晶圓廠已完成建設，預計2027年第三季開始量產，時程較原先規劃提前。
除了亞利桑那州，台積電也正在評估德州設廠機會。魏哲家表示，由於美國大型客戶希望增加當地晶片製造能力，公司已派遣團隊赴德州進行評估，美國政府也對相關擴產計畫表達支持。
針對特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克提出的Terafab AI晶片製造計畫，台積電表示雙方已進行討論，但強調若未來展開晶圓廠合作，相關製造設施仍必須由台積電自行營運。
另一方面，先進封裝CoWoS需求仍維持強勁，成為支撐AI晶片供應鏈投資的重要環節。半導體設備大廠艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-NL)也指出，部分客戶已開始洽談2029年至2030年的設備訂單，顯示大型晶片製造商的長期產能規劃仍持續推進。

paras_en: October 15, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center) – TSMC (2330‑TW) posted a record‑high Q3 earnings report, boosted by continued strong demand for artificial‑intelligence (AI) chips. Quarterly net profit reached NT$763.1 billion, up 69% year‑over‑year and ahead of market estimates of NT$746.3 billion, marking the sixth consecutive quarter of profit records. However, CEO Wei Zhe‑jia said that despite the very strong AI demand and no signs of slowdown, the company will stay cautious about its 2027 operating plan due to overall economic uncertainty and component price hikes affecting end‑markets.

TSMC’s Q3 revenue grew 50% year‑over‑year, also a historic high, and the company lifted its full‑year 2026 revenue growth outlook from “over 40%” to about 44%. It noted that customer demand still far exceeds capacity, with AI accelerators driving advanced‑process demand and Agentic AI‑related CPUs and networking chips expected to become further sources of wafer demand.

Looking ahead to Q4, TSMC forecasts revenue of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion, versus $33.73 billion in the same quarter last year, a maximum year‑over‑year increase of roughly 61%. The company also maintains its 2026 capital‑expenditure plan of $60 billion to $64 billion, reflecting the need to keep expanding advanced‑process and advanced‑packaging capacity to meet customer demand.

Even with strong AI‑related orders, Wei warned that consumer electronics and price‑sensitive end‑markets are feeling pressure from rising component costs and overall economic uncertainty. This forces TSMC to weigh rapid AI demand growth against possible stress in other end‑markets when planning 2027 capacity and investment.

In the United States, TSMC is planning to invest $265 billion to build a semiconductor manufacturing campus in Arizona, including an additional $100 billion announced in July 2026. The second fab has been completed and is expected to start volume production in Q3 2027, ahead of the original schedule.

Beyond Arizona, TSMC is also evaluating a potential plant in Texas. Wei said that because major U.S. customers want more local chip‑making capacity, the company has sent a team to assess Texas, and the U.S. government has expressed support for the expansion plans.

Regarding Tesla CEO Elon Musk’s proposed Terafab AI chip‑manufacturing project, TSMC said discussions have taken place but stressed that any future fab collaboration would require the manufacturing facilities to be operated solely by TSMC.

On the other hand, demand for advanced packaging CoWoS remains strong, serving as a key pillar supporting AI‑chip supply‑chain investment. Semiconductor‑equipment giant ASML (ASML‑NL) also noted that some customers have begun talks for equipment orders for 2029‑2030, indicating that large‑chip makers’ long‑term capacity plans are still progressing.

items.title: 台積電法說會重點：2026年營收成長44%、AI需求超預期，2奈米與海外擴產成毛利率關鍵
items.title_en: TSMC Earnings Call Highlights: 44% Revenue Growth Forecast for 2026, AI Demand Exceeds Expectations, 2nm and Overseas Expansion Key to Margins
paras:
台積電法說會的核心重點整理
台積電(2330-TW)受惠AI晶片需求強勁，第三季淨利(7,631億元)與營收均創歷史新高，並將2026全年營收成長預期上調至約44%。預估第四季營收最高年增61%，資本支出維持600億至640億美元以擴充先進製程與CoWoS產能。雖AI需求遠超供給，但受零組件漲價與總經不確定性衝擊消費性電子影響，公司對2027年營運規劃持審慎態度。
美國亞利桑那州二廠進度超前，預計提前於2027年第三季量產；同時亦已派團隊評估德州設廠，並強調若與特斯拉Terafab計畫合作，廠房必須由台積電營運。此外，CoWoS需求持續強勁，且ASML已出現2029至2030年設備訂單洽談，顯示大型晶片製造商仍積極進行長線產能規劃。

一、財務表現與未來展望


Q3財報超標：Q3營收達467億美元(季增16.2%)，超越財測高標；毛利率66.4%(受2奈米初期量產稀釋影響)，EPS為新台幣29.43元。
Q4與全年展望：預估Q4營收落在523億至543億美元之間(中位數季增14%)；上調2026全年美元營收成長率至約44%。
資本支出維持高檔：2026年資本支出維持600億至640億美元；並預告2026至2028年的資本支出將顯著高於過去3年，以應付強勁成長需求。
毛利率稀釋因素：海外廠2026年毛利稀釋約2%，未來幾年將擴大至3%~4%；2奈米量產也會持續帶來毛利稀釋，但將透過定價策略與成本控管抵銷。

二、AI需求與終端市場動態


AI需求「極度強勁」：受惠於代理式AI(Agentic AI)與開源模型普及，AI晶片需求持續遠大於供給，成長毫無放緩跡象。
終端市場兩極化：雖然AI需求暴增，但消費性與價格敏感的傳統終端市場(如非AI手機或PC)仍受高通膨與總經不確定性挑戰，台積電對2027年非AI業務規劃持謹慎態度。

三、先進製程與技術藍圖


2奈米(N2)進度良好：已於2025年Q4順利量產，受智慧型手機與HPC需求推動，預期2027年產能將翻倍。
A14節點展望：預計2027年風險試產、2028年量產。客戶導入狀況踴躍，預期A14將成為比2奈米規模更大的節點。
3奈米持續擴產：因需求強勁，決定在台南園區「再增建一座」3奈米廠，預計2028年上半年量產。
High-NA EUV導入時程：預計在2030年成熟並具備成本效益時才會投入量產，有信心在不搶先採用的情況下維持技術領先。

四、全球佈局與海外擴張


美國擴廠加速與新評估：亞利桑那州第二座晶圓廠進度超前，提前於2027年Q3量產。目前正評估在德州擴產的可能性(包含與Terafab討論合作，但廠房必須由台積電營運)。
日本佈局：日本第二廠(導入3奈米)進展順利，預計2028年量產。
電力疑慮排除：針對市場擔憂的AI資料中心供電問題，台積電已派團隊實地查核美國電力供應與建設進度，確認一切良好。

五、先進封裝與供應鏈合作


CoWoS領先優勢：目前是唯一能量產5倍光罩尺寸先進封裝的公司，良率優異；正持續推進9倍與14倍光罩尺寸技術。
結盟GlobalFoundries：因應後段封裝產能短缺，與GlobalFoundries簽署協議，由其提供矽中介層(Silicon Interposer)，共同滿足客戶龐大的AI晶片需求。

paras_en: Key points from TSMC's earnings call: Benefiting from strong AI chip demand, the company posted record Q3 net profit (NT$763.1 billion) and revenue, and has raised its 2026 full‑year revenue growth outlook to about 44%. It expects Q4 revenue to grow up to 61% year‑over‑year and will keep capital expenditures at $60‑$64 billion to expand advanced process and CoWoS capacity. Although AI demand far outstrips supply, higher component prices and macro‑economic uncertainty are hurting consumer electronics, so the firm remains cautious about its 2027 operating plan.

The second fab in Arizona is ahead of schedule and is expected to start volume production in Q3 2027; a team is also evaluating a Texas plant and stresses that any partnership with Tesla’s Terafab project would require the facility to be operated by TSMC. CoWoS demand stays robust, and ASML has already begun talks for equipment orders for 2029‑2030, indicating that large‑chip makers continue to plan long‑term capacity.

1. Financial performance and outlook

Q3 results beat expectations: Q3 revenue reached $46.7 billion (up 16.2% sequentially), surpassing the high end of forecasts; gross margin was 66.4% (affected by early‑stage 2nm volume dilution), and earnings per share were NT$29.43.
Q4 and full‑year outlook: Q4 revenue is projected between $52.3 billion and $54.3 billion (mid‑point up 14% sequentially); the 2026 full‑year revenue growth rate in USD is lifted to roughly 44%.

Capital spending remains elevated: 2026 capex will stay at $60‑$64 billion, and the company warned that capex for 2026‑2028 will be significantly higher than the past three years to meet strong growth demand.

Gross‑margin dilution factors: Overseas fabs are expected to dilute the 2026 gross margin by about 2%, rising to 3‑4% in the coming years; 2nm volume production will also continue to dilute margins, but pricing strategy and cost control are expected to offset the impact.

2. AI demand and end‑market dynamics

AI demand is "extremely strong": Driven by the rise of agentic AI and open‑source models, AI chip demand remains far above supply with no sign of slowdown.

End‑market polarization: While AI demand is booming, price‑sensitive consumer segments such as non‑AI phones or PCs face inflation and macro‑economic headwinds, leading TSMC to take a cautious stance on non‑AI business plans for 2027.

3. Advanced processes and technology roadmap

2nm (N2) progress is good: Volume production started smoothly in Q4 2025, boosted by smartphone and HPC demand, and capacity is expected to double by 2027.
A14 node outlook: Risk‑run pilot is slated for 2027 with volume production in 2028. Customer adoption is enthusiastic, and A14 is expected to become a larger‑scale node than 2nm.
3nm continues to expand: Strong demand prompted the decision to add another 3nm fab at the Tainan campus, with volume production targeted for the first half of 2028.

High‑NA EUV adoption timeline: Mass production will only commence once the technology matures and becomes cost‑effective around 2030, with confidence that TSMC can stay ahead without premature adoption.

4. Global footprint and overseas expansion

Accelerated US expansion and new assessments: The second wafer fab in Arizona is ahead of schedule, moving up to Q3 2027 for volume production. TSMC is currently assessing a possible expansion in Texas (including discussions with Terafab, but any plant must be operated by TSMC).
Japan footprint: The second Japanese fab (introducing 3nm) is progressing smoothly and is expected to reach volume production in 2028.

Power‑supply concerns cleared: To address market worries about power for AI data centers, TSMC sent a team to inspect U.S. power supply and construction progress, confirming everything is satisfactory.

5. Advanced packaging and supply‑chain collaboration

CoWoS leadership: TSMC is currently the only company able to mass‑produce advanced packages with 5× mask size, delivering excellent yields, and is pushing forward with 9× and 14× mask size technologies.

Alliance with GlobalFoundries: To address downstream packaging capacity shortages, TSMC signed an agreement with GlobalFoundries for silicon interposer supply, jointly meeting the massive AI chip demand of customers.
