items.title: 美國八州控告OpenAI！指ChatGPT危害兒童並欺騙家長
items.title_en: Eight U.S. States Sue OpenAI, Claiming ChatGPT Harms Children and Deceives Parents
paras: 美國八個州周三(14日)分別對OpenAI提起訴訟，指控這家人工智慧(AI)公司旗下的ChatGPT聊天機器人是不安全的產品，已傷害兒童並欺騙家長。
愛荷華州檢察長Brenna Bird表示，愛荷華州、堪薩斯州、內布拉斯加州、西維吉尼亞州、阿肯色州、亞利桑那州、愛達荷州及蒙大拿州，已各自在州法院對OpenAI提告。Bird指出，愛阿華州的訴訟旨在維護受到OpenAI「蓄意、危險、魯莽且違法」行為影響的民眾權益。
Bird說：「OpenAI一方面宣稱ChatGPT安全，另一方面卻提供危險的醫療建議、鼓勵傷害他人，甚至指導使用者輕生，還假裝是使用者的朋友。」她強調，訴訟目的是保護兒童，並依州法追究OpenAI責任。
OpenAI發言人Drew Pusateri表示，該公司已在產品中建立針對不同年齡層的保護機制，這是許多其他AI產品所欠缺的。OpenAI也正與各州合作，推動適用於整個產業的政策。
Pusateri說，沒有任何系統能做到完美，但公司將持續與專家合作，增設防護措施，包括家長監護功能、休息提醒及符合年齡需求的模型保護機制。
OpenAI近來面臨日益升高的安全審查。在多起非正常死亡訴訟中，ChatGPT被指導致使用者陷入有害妄想，部分案例甚至涉及輕生。佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier也在6月控告OpenAI，指控該公司明知產品可能危害使用者，仍推出不安全的產品。
過去一年來，OpenAI陸續強化家長與兒童安全功能，並於8月推出專為未成年人設計的「ChatGPT for Teens」，透過教育功能及符合年齡需求的防護措施，減少青少年接觸不適齡或有害內容。
OpenAI當時表示，青少年應能利用AI學習、創作與探索，但也應獲得符合其發展階段的保護，並維護現實人際關係及健康使用習慣。
paras_en: On Wednesday, the 14th, eight U.S. states filed lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging that the company’s ChatGPT chatbot is an unsafe product that has harmed children and misled parents.

Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana have each filed suits against OpenAI in their state courts. Bird noted that Iowa’s lawsuit aims to protect the rights of people affected by OpenAI’s “deliberate, dangerous, reckless and unlawful” conduct.

Bird said, “OpenAI claims ChatGPT is safe while it provides dangerous medical advice, encourages harm to others, even guides users toward suicide, and pretends to be a friend.” She emphasized that the suit is intended to protect children and hold OpenAI accountable under state law.

OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has built age‑specific safety mechanisms into its product, something many other AI offerings lack, and that OpenAI is working with the states to develop industry‑wide policies.
Pusateri added that no system is perfect, but the company will keep working with experts to add safeguards, including parental‑control features, break reminders and age‑appropriate model protections.

OpenAI has recently faced heightened safety scrutiny. In multiple wrongful‑death suits, ChatGPT was alleged to have driven users into harmful delusions, with some cases involving suicide. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier also sued OpenAI in June, accusing the firm of releasing an unsafe product despite knowing it could endanger users.

Over the past year, OpenAI has incrementally strengthened parental and child safety tools and in August launched a teen‑focused version, “ChatGPT for Teens,” which uses educational features and age‑appropriate safeguards to limit minors’ exposure to unsuitable or harmful content.

OpenAI said at the time that teenagers should be able to use AI for learning, creation and exploration, but also deserve protections suited to their developmental stage, while maintaining real‑world relationships and healthy usage habits.

items.title: 另闢蹊徑與數位轉型：朱曉靜帶領沃爾瑪中國走向全通路零售新局
items.title_en: Charting New Paths and Digital Transformation: Zhu Xiaojing Leads Walmart China into a New Era of Omnichannel Retail
paras: 沃爾瑪在進入中國市場三十周年之際，由首位中國籍女性總裁兼首席執行官朱曉靜領軍，成功實現戰略轉型。2020 年朱曉靜接任時，傳統量販店市場面臨失速，外資同行陸續退場。面對經營壓力，她帶領團隊重新定位，引導公司從傳統實體門市轉型為全通路零售商。
在業務策略上，沃爾瑪中國將山姆會員店打造成為核心成長引擎。透過精選商品品項與供應鏈深度客製化，山姆會員店目前貢獻了中國區約 80% 的收入，付費會員數自 2019 年的約 200 萬人增加至突破 1,070 萬人。
同時，公司主動進行門市結構調整，減少大型賣場並加速布局社區店與新一代門市，計畫完成百餘家存量門市煥新。
根據 2026 年 8 月發布的 2027 財年第二季財報，沃爾瑪中國淨銷售額達 70 億美元，年增 20.7%；其中電子商務銷售額年增 26%，占整體銷售比重提升至 55%，淨銷售增速遠高於同期美國市場的 3.5%。這項亮眼表現讓朱曉靜成為首位登上沃爾瑪全球投資人會議講台的中國區掌舵人，彰顯中國市場的戰略價值。
除了實體與電商通路，朱曉靜格外強調科技在零售轉型中的核心地位。她指出，中國消費者對高效率服務(如 30 分鐘送達)的要求，已使當地成為全球數位零售試驗場。在 2026 年飛書未來無限大會上，朱曉靜表示：「如今所有零售企業，本質上也都必須成為科技公司。」
她認為，布局人工智慧(AI)的重心不在於模型本身，而是系統，須將技術與顧客場景、專屬資料、業務流程及實體營運體系深度對接，才能創造差異化優勢。
在早前媒體採訪時，朱曉靜回顧轉型歷程，她引述創辦人山姆·沃爾頓(Sam Walton)「Swim upstream」的商場法則，澄清其意涵並非單純逆境抗爭，而是「另闢蹊徑，走一條不尋常的路」。她表示：「我只有一個老闆——就是中國消費者。」
她強調，儘管外部技術與環境變化迅速，沃爾瑪「幫顧客省錢，讓他們生活得更好」的核心使命將始終保持不變。
paras_en: As Walmart marks its thirtieth anniversary in the Chinese market, it has successfully completed a strategic transformation under the leadership of its first Chinese‑born female president and CEO, Zhu Xiaojing. When Zhu took over in 2020, the traditional hyper‑market segment was stagnating and foreign competitors were exiting. Facing operational pressure, she re‑positioned the business, steering the company from a conventional brick‑and‑mortar retailer to an omnichannel retailer.

In its business strategy, Walmart China has made Sam’s Club the core growth engine. By offering a curated selection of products and deeply customized supply‑chain solutions, Sam’s Club now accounts for roughly 80% of Walmart China’s revenue, and paid membership has risen from about 2 million in 2019 to over 10.7 million.

At the same time, the company is proactively reshaping its store footprint, reducing the number of large‑format hypermarkets while accelerating the rollout of community stores and next‑generation formats, with plans to refresh more than a hundred existing locations.

According to the second‑quarter financial results for fiscal year 2027 released in August 2026, Walmart China’s net sales reached $7 billion, up 20.7% year‑over‑year; e‑commerce sales grew 26% annually, lifting its share of total sales to 55%, a growth rate far outpacing the U.S. market’s 3.5% in the same period. This standout performance made Zhu Xiaojing the first China leader to speak at Walmart’s global investor meeting, underscoring the strategic value of the Chinese market.

Beyond physical and online channels, Zhu places particular emphasis on technology as the core of retail transformation. She notes that Chinese consumers’ demand for high‑efficiency services—such as 30‑minute delivery—has turned the country into a global testing ground for digital retail. Speaking at the 2026 Feishu Future Unlimited Conference, Zhu said, “Today every retail company essentially has to become a technology company.”

She believes that the focus of AI deployment should be on systems rather than models, requiring deep integration of technology with customer scenarios, proprietary data, business processes, and the physical operating framework to create differentiated advantages.

In an earlier media interview, Zhu reflected on the transformation journey, quoting founder Sam Walton’s “Swim upstream” business principle and clarifying that it means “paving a new path, taking an unconventional route” rather than merely fighting adversity. She added, “I have only one boss—China’s consumers.”
She stressed that despite rapid external technological and environmental changes, Walmart’s core mission—“help customers save money and live better”—will remain unchanged.

items.title: 稅改+移民執法雙殺！川普高喊「美國夢回來了」　美媒卻在亞利桑那州見到飢餓與憤怒
items.title_en: Tax Reform and Immigration Enforcement Double Whammy! Trump Shouts "American Dream Is Back" While U.S. Media See Hunger and Anger in Arizona
paras: 美媒最新報導指出，亞利桑那州一位退休行政助理、曾任法庭書記的婦女索托已從食品銀行捐贈者變成受助者。她說，超市罐裝蔬菜價格每次都悄悄漲價，預算逼人時只能買便宜魚排或罐頭肉，牛肉、禽肉不考慮，有時甚至空手回家。「川普說經濟繁榮，我看不到。」
《大西洋月刊》報導，一輛綿延近一英里的車隊停在高海拔沙漠公路旁，起初以為出車禍，靠近才發現是居民排隊領取食物，凸顯美國民眾在總統川普的經濟下挨餓，而此前川普才高喊「美國夢回來了」。
兩年前，索托投票給川普，期待在拜登時期通膨飆升後「讓美國再次負擔得起」，但她的丈夫頸傷手術後無法工作，微薄退休金又讓她不符公共援助資格，油價與糧價持續上漲，66歲的她只好拋下羞恥感，開車20英里到普雷斯科特社區糧庫。她形容，對老人而言，「排隊領糧是極大犧牲」。
糧食援助收緊是核心變數。自2025年夏季起，川普標誌性稅法調整連動SNAP(補充營養援助計畫，俗稱食品券)資格，限制給付額度、提高工作證明與錯誤率標準，並對發放出錯的州扣減聯邦資金；亞利桑那是最早落實的州之一，當地約50萬人因新規失去食品券資格。
自新規去年7月生效至今年1月，SNAP月領人數由約4210萬降至3850萬、減幅逾8%；亞利桑那州實施後參與人數一度驟降約五成。工作要求方面，65歲以下、無重大健康限制者須按月證明工作、受教育或受訓至少80小時，退伍軍人、無家者、育有未成年子女家長等原豁免群也多納入；2028會計年度起，各州錯誤率超過6%須自擔部分聯邦成本，地方審核趨嚴。
食品銀行需求隨之翻倍。根據亞利桑那州食品銀行網絡統計，2024年月均服務62萬6881人，今年月均則約78萬6366人。
普雷斯科特社區糧庫執行主任菲爾普斯說，曾接獲17名退伍軍人「完全無糧」通報，連夜用電動車運兩趟物資。68歲殘疾老兵布拉農的補助被砍到每月60美元，過10號就「只能挨餓」；32歲前憲兵里斯克抱嬰兒排隊，因資格更新延誤失去月約780美元糧補，改做遛狗兼職、伴侶打零工撐家。
全職母親布羅夫斯基則因為亞利桑那州府執行新資格要求，每月失去800美元食品券；續領走到個案面談最後一步，卻一連數日打不通亞利桑那經濟安全廳專線，最後放棄，改到平價商店採買。
丈夫在汽車零件店收入不敷家用，免費食物箱常有過期品或高糖甜點，孩子只能吃微波廉價餐，布羅夫斯基用幫鄰居遛狗、幫兒子生日辦「寵物樂園」以物易物換服務。
2024年投票給川普的美髮師齊默曼，如今抱怨護髮品與來客皆喊道「物價失控，大家慌了」，並質疑川普把責任推得一乾二淨、與基層痛感脫節。
就業與物價形成雙重壓力。根據聯邦數據，亞利桑那州失業率自2024年8月3.8%升至今年8月4.9%，多數受訪者仍在工作，但薪資追不上汽油、食品漲幅。2024年川普在亞瓦普郡得票約66%，原是衝抵民主黨反撲的紅堡，但受訪共和黨人普遍認為當前生活比2024年更糟，對國會與兩黨皆失望，並批評聯邦把資金用於戰爭、首都裝飾，而非降物價。

移民執法再加一層不確定。根據親移民團體America's Voice報告指出，大規模驅逐非法移民推高食品、住宅與醫療成本，稱之為「ICE稅」，報告也引用去年6月至今年6月物價資料，生菜漲32.1%、罐頭水果漲7.9%、柑橘與蘋果分別漲6.3%、7.1%。普雷斯科特谷一家肉店外今夏曾有聯邦執法行動，業者稱顧客受驚、生意下滑；一名37歲女性拒曝全名，說丈夫被遣返後獨自管家與屋頂公司，勞動力短缺、食品價高，短期不看好反轉。
支持嚴打非法移民的農村選民同時承受物價與社區恐懼，政策紅利與民生成本明顯錯位。
整體來看，SNAP收緊、AI與伺服器需求無關的通用通膨、移民勞動力減少與小鎮商業冷清，正把「美國夢回來」的口號拉回現實帳單。
對索托、東布羅夫斯基、布拉農這類偏鄉家庭而言，重點不是華府敘事，而是冰箱有無肉菜、油費能否負擔、下個月糧補是否還在。食品銀行可補一時，卻補不上被資格門檻與物價上漲同時壓縮的家庭預算。
paras_en: A recent U.S. media report says a retired administrative assistant and former court clerk in Arizona, Sotto, has gone from being a donor to a recipient at a food bank. She says canned vegetable prices at supermarkets quietly rise each time, and when the budget is tight she can only afford cheap fish fillets or canned meat, ruling out beef and poultry, sometimes even coming home empty‑handed. "Trump talks about economic prosperity, but I don’t see it," she says.

The Atlantic described a convoy nearly a mile long parked beside a high‑altitude desert highway. At first it looked like a crash site, but getting closer revealed residents queuing for food, highlighting how Americans are going hungry under President Trump’s economy, even as he was loudly proclaiming "the American Dream is back."

Two years ago Sotto voted for Trump, hoping that after the inflation surge under Biden the country would become affordable again. After her husband’s neck surgery left him unable to work, their modest pension made her ineligible for public assistance. With gas and food prices climbing, the 66‑year‑old had to swallow her pride and drive 20 miles to the Prescote community food pantry. She describes queuing for food as a huge sacrifice for seniors.

Tightening food‑assistance eligibility is a key factor. Starting in the summer of 2025, Trump’s signature tax changes tie SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, commonly known as food stamps) eligibility to lower benefit caps, stricter work‑verification and error‑rate standards, and federal funding cuts for states that mishandle distributions. Arizona was among the first to implement the rules, causing roughly 500,000 residents to lose SNAP eligibility.

From the rule’s rollout in July last year through January this year, SNAP enrollment fell from about 42.1 million to 38.5 million, a drop of over 8 %. After Arizona’s implementation, participation briefly plunged by roughly half. The work‑requirement now obliges anyone under 65 without a major health limitation to prove each month at least 80 hours of work, education or training; veterans, the homeless and parents of minor children, previously exempt, are now largely included. Beginning fiscal year 2028, states with error rates above 6 % must shoulder part of the federal cost, tightening local audits.
Food‑bank demand has doubled. Arizona’s food‑bank network reports an average of 626,881 people served per month in 2024, rising to about 786,366 per month this year.

Prescote Community Food Pantry director Philps said they received reports from 17 veterans who were "completely out of food" and dispatched two electric‑vehicle trips of supplies overnight. Disabled 68‑year‑old veteran Branong saw his subsidy cut to $60 a month and after the 10th of the month he "can only starve"; 32‑year‑old former MP Risch, holding a baby in line, lost roughly $780 a month in food aid due to a delayed eligibility update and now supplements income by dog‑walking and his partner’s odd jobs.

Full‑time mother Brovski lost $800 a month in food stamps after Arizona’s new eligibility rules. She got as far as the final case‑interview step, then couldn’t reach the state’s Economic Security Department for several days and gave up, turning to discount stores for groceries.

Her husband’s auto‑parts shop earnings don’t cover household costs; the free food boxes often contain expired items or sugary snacks, and the children survive on cheap microwave meals. Brovski trades dog‑walking for neighbors and runs a "pet playground" birthday party for her son to barter services.

2024 Trump‑supporting hairstylist Zimmerman now complains that hair‑care products and customers alike are shouting "prices are out of control, everyone’s panicking," and he blames Trump for shifting responsibility entirely and being out of touch with grassroots hardship.

Employment and prices create a double squeeze. Federal data show Arizona’s unemployment rate rose from 3.8 % in August 2024 to 4.9 % in August 2025. Most respondents are still employed, but wages lag behind gasoline and food price hikes. In 2024 Trump captured about 66 % of the vote in Yavapai County, a former red‑fort stronghold meant to counter Democratic gains, yet surveyed Republicans say life is worse than in 2024, are disappointed with both Congress and the parties, and criticize the federal government for spending money on wars and capital projects instead of lowering prices.

Immigration enforcement adds another layer of uncertainty. A report by pro‑immigrant group America’s Voice says large‑scale deportations of undocumented migrants raise food, housing and medical costs, dubbing it an "ICE tax." The report cites price data from June 2023 to June 2024 showing lettuce up 32.1 %, canned fruit up 7.9 %, citrus and apples up 6.3 % and 7.1 % respectively. A meat shop in Prescote Valley saw a federal law‑enforcement action this summer; the owner says customers were frightened and sales fell. A 37‑year‑old woman, who declined to give her full name, says her husband was deported, leaving her to run a housekeeping and roofing business amid labor shortages and high food prices, and she sees no short‑term turnaround.

Rural voters who back a hard line on illegal immigration are simultaneously bearing the brunt of higher prices and community fear, revealing a stark mismatch between policy benefits and ordinary costs.

Overall, tighter SNAP rules, generic inflation unrelated to AI or server demand, reduced immigrant labor and sluggish small‑town commerce are pulling the "American Dream is back" slogan back onto the reality bill.

For families like Sotto, East Brovski and Branong in remote areas, the focus isn’t the Capitol narrative but whether the fridge holds meat and vegetables, whether they can afford fuel, and whether next month’s food aid will still arrive. Food banks can fill a gap temporarily, but they cannot offset family budgets squeezed by eligibility thresholds and rising prices.

items.title: 從挖礦到千億AI算力巨獸 被黃仁勳看中 Nscale衝刺350億美元IPO
items.title_en: From Mining to a Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar AI Compute Beast: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Takes Interest as Nscale Targets a $35 Billion IPO
paras: 全球 AI 基礎設施領域迎來重量級里程碑。總部位於倫敦的全端 AI 算力雲端服務商 Nscale 已正式向美國 SEC 遞交 S-1 招股書，預計於紐約證券交易所(NYSE)掛牌上市，股票代碼 NSCL，計畫籌集高達 30 億美元資金，市場預估其估值最高可達 350 億美元。
由高盛、摩根大通與摩根士丹利組成的豪華承銷團隊操盤，Nscale 的估值在短短半年內自 2026 年 3 月 C 輪融資時的 146 億美元實現暴增翻倍。

從16歲輟學煤礦工到算力帝國CEO

Nscale 戲劇性的崛起歷程，離不開其創建人兼 CEO Josh Payne 的草根轉型故事。Payne 16 歲時自高中輟學，曾於澳洲工業區擔任煤礦工人與建築工地起重機指揮員。其後自學商業與金融知識，於 2019 至 2020 年間共同創立比特幣挖礦業者 Arkon Energy。
2023 年加密貨幣市場低迷之際，Payne 敏銳捕捉到生成式 AI 爆發帶來的 GPU 算力荒，果斷將「低價過剩電力＋高密度計算」的挖礦營運經驗轉向 AI 領域。2024 年 5 月，Nscale 正式自 Arkon 分拆獨立。
透過收購土地、挪威水電與微電網資源，Nscale 實現了電力、數據中心與 GPU 叢集的垂直整合，其電力管線展望已突破 10 GW。

微軟、Anthropic 與字節跳動的算力綁定

根據招股書披露，Nscale 的活躍與已簽約總合約價值(TCV)高達 1,034 億美元。其中高達 85% 的營收綁定於兩大 AI 巨頭：
微軟(MSFT-US)： 簽署至 2033 年、總額達 438 億美元 的算力供應協議。
Anthropic： 簽署高達 446 億至 450 億美元 的 GPU 服務合約，預計於西弗吉尼亞園區部署輝達 Vera Rubin 系列晶片。
此外，據《金融時報》報導與 SEC 文件佐證，字節跳動旗下新加坡實體 Spring (SG) Pte Ltd 為其早期隱形大客戶，在 2025 年貢獻了 Nscale 3,300 萬美元營收中的 73%。Nscale 重金挖角前阿里雲高管 Jiny Yin 掌管亞洲雲端與電商業務。

輝達重倉與明星董事會加持

身為晶片龍頭的輝達(NVDA-US)，不僅持有 Nscale 超過 5% 股權，更在 2026 年 9 月參與其 31 億美元可轉換債券融資並認購 10 億美元，累計資本支持已逾 20 億美元。此外，Nscale 董事會邀集前 Meta 營運長 Sheryl Sandberg、前 Meta 全球事務總裁 Nick Clegg 以及前 OpenAI 高管 Fidji Simo 入列，展現極強的企業治理與戰略資源背景。
儘管合約數字驚人，Nscale 在 2026 年上半年營收達 1.406 億美元(年增 1,252%)的同時，淨虧損亦擴大至 10.2 億美元。
《Startup Fortune》專欄作者 Walter Schulze 指出， Nscale 在招股書中曾警示其對「持續經營的能力存在重大疑慮」。雖然管理層主張延後部分資本支出可舒緩資金壓力，但這向監管機構證實公司曾面臨資金耗盡邊緣，這種流動性風險比單純的擴充期虧損更值得投資人警惕。
EBC Financial Group 分析師 Benny Lam 評估，350 億美元估值的合理性完全取決於能否將簽約合約轉化為實際營運收入，而非當前獲利。
Benny Lam 分析，10.2 億美元淨虧損包含 4.571 億美元的公允價值調整與 1.74 億美元折舊攤銷，實際營運虧損為 4.92 億美元。更關鍵的是，截至 2026 年 8 月底，1,034 億美元 TCV 中僅 26 億美元(約 2.5%)處於活躍狀態，46.1 萬塊 GPU 中僅 2.5 萬塊(5.4%)上線運作，未來仍面臨龐大的基礎建設融資挑戰。
paras_en: Global AI infrastructure reaches a heavyweight milestone. London‑based end‑to‑end AI compute cloud provider Nscale has filed an S‑1 with the U.S. SEC, planning to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker NSCL and raise up to $3 billion, with market estimates valuing the company at as much as $35 billion.

A star underwriting syndicate led by Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Morgan Stanley is handling the deal, and Nscale’s valuation has more than doubled in just six months, jumping from $14.6 billion at its Series C round in March 2026.

From a 16‑year‑old high‑school dropout coal miner to the CEO of a compute empire. The dramatic rise of Nscale is inseparable from its founder and CEO Josh Payne’s grassroots transformation. Payne left high school at 16, worked as a coal miner and crane operator at an Australian industrial site, then taught himself business and finance and co‑founded the Bitcoin mining firm Arkon Energy between 2019 and 2020.

When the cryptocurrency market slumped in 2023, Payne keenly sensed the GPU compute shortage sparked by the generative‑AI boom and decisively pivoted Arkon’s “low‑cost excess power + high‑density compute” mining expertise toward AI. In May 2024, Nscale was spun out of Arkon as an independent entity.
By acquiring land, Norwegian hydropower and micro‑grid assets, Nscale has achieved vertical integration of power, data centers and GPU clusters, with its power pipeline outlook now exceeding 10 GW.

Microsoft, Anthropic and ByteDance power‑binding contracts. The prospectus discloses that Nscale’s active and signed total contract value (TCV) reaches $103.4 billion, with as much as 85% of revenue tied to two major AI giants.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US): a compute‑supply agreement through 2033 worth $43.8 billion.
Anthropic: a GPU‑service contract valued between $44.6 billion and $45.0 billion, with plans to deploy Nvidia Vera Rubin chips at its West Virginia campus.

In addition, according to the Financial Times and SEC filings, ByteDance’s Singapore entity Spring (SG) Pte Ltd was an early hidden major customer, contributing 73% of Nscale’s $33 million revenue in 2025. Nscale also poached former Alibaba Cloud executive Jiny Yin to run its Asia cloud and e‑commerce business.

Nvidia heavy‑holds and star‑studded board. Chip leader Nvidia (NVDA‑US) not only owns more than 5% of Nscale but participated in a $3.1 billion convertible‑bond financing in September 2026, purchasing $1 billion of the bonds, bringing total capital support to over $2 billion. Nscale’s board includes former Meta COO Sheryl Sandberg, former Meta Global Affairs President Nick Clegg and former OpenAI executive Fidji Simo, underscoring strong governance and strategic resources.
Despite the impressive contract figures, Nscale posted first‑half‑2026 revenue of $140.6 million (a 1,252% year‑over‑year increase) while its net loss widened to $1.02 billion.

Startup Fortune columnist Walter Schulze noted that Nscale warned in its filing of “material doubts about its ability to continue as a going concern.” Although management says postponing some capital expenditures can ease cash pressure, this confirms to regulators that the company has been on the brink of cash exhaustion, a liquidity risk that investors should heed more than mere expansion‑phase losses.

EBC Financial Group analyst Benny Lam assessed that the reasonableness of a $35 billion valuation hinges entirely on converting signed contracts into actual operating revenue, not on current profitability.

Benny Lam further broke down the $1.02 billion net loss: $457.1 million stems from fair‑value adjustments and $174 million from depreciation and amortization, leaving an operating loss of $492 million. More critically, as of the end of August 2026, only $2.6 billion (about 2.5%) of the $103.4 billion TCV is active, and only 25,000 of the 461,000 GPUs (5.4%) are online, indicating a massive infrastructure financing challenge ahead.

items.title: 記憶體成本飆升重創手機市場！第3季出貨量暴跌22%史上最慘 IDC：谷底還沒到
items.title_en: Memory Costs Soar, Crushing the Smartphone Market! Q3 Shipments Plunge 22% – Worst Ever, IDC Says Bottom Not Yet Reached
paras: 根據市場研究機構IDC統計，受記憶體成本上升影響，全球智慧手機市場第3季出貨量下滑22%，遭遇有史以來最嚴重的衰退，而且情況可能進一步惡化。
IDC表示，在人工智慧(AI)產業訂單需求帶動下，過去一年儲存設備成本上升，已衝擊整個行動裝置產業的獲利能力，迫使業者調漲價格、縮減產品規格，並放棄以平價市場為主的機種。
在主要品牌中，小米(01810-HK)與OPPO等中國品牌受到的衝擊最嚴重，蘋果(AAPL-US)與三星電子則因高階手機產品占比較高，表現相對穩健。
手機製造商日益意識到，產業正面臨永久的結構性轉變。IDC目前預料，智慧手機市場最快也要等到2028年才可能恢復成長。
隨著業者調漲價格，並引導消費者轉向旗艦機或超高階機種，時間一長，這項趨勢可能讓蘋果及其他具備大規模通路、且高階產品占比較高的業者，在規模縮小的市場中取得更大的市占率。
IDC研究總監Nabila Popal說：「目前的指標顯示，市場尚未觸底。記憶體成本自去年以來已飆升約350%，而且仍在持續上漲，對手機業者的利潤率與出貨量造成重大壓力。」
她警告：「最糟糕的時刻還在後頭。」
paras_en: According to market research firm IDC, rising memory costs have caused global smartphone shipments in Q3 to fall 22%, marking the most severe downturn in history and potentially worsening further.

IDC says that driven by AI industry order demand, storage equipment costs have risen over the past year, hitting the profitability of the entire mobile device sector, forcing manufacturers to raise prices, trim product specifications, and abandon models aimed at the budget market.

Among major brands, Chinese makers such as Xiaomi (01810-HK) and OPPO have been hit hardest, while Apple (AAPL-US) and Samsung Electronics have fared relatively steadier due to a higher share of premium smartphones.
Phone makers are increasingly aware that the industry is undergoing a permanent structural shift. IDC now forecasts that the smartphone market may not see growth again until as early as 2028.

As manufacturers raise prices and steer consumers toward flagship or ultra‑premium devices, this trend could, over time, allow Apple and other firms with large distribution networks and a high proportion of premium products to capture a larger share in a shrinking market.

IDC research director Nabila Popal said, "Current indicators show the market has not yet hit bottom. Memory costs have surged about 350% since last year and continue to rise, putting significant pressure on smartphone makers' profit margins and shipment volumes."
She warned, "The worst is yet to come."

items.title: 蘋果躋身5兆美元俱樂部後能否站穩？7.49萬元起摺疊iPhone將迎關鍵考驗
items.title_en: Can Apple Stay Firm After Joining the $5 Trillion Club? Foldable iPhone Starting at $7,490 Faces Crucial Test
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(14日)加入輝達的行列，成為全球第二家收盤市值突破5兆美元的企業，與科技股的疲弱走勢形成強烈對比。《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)指出，即將上市的摺疊iPhone，將成為檢驗投資人信心能否續航的重要考驗。
蘋果周三股價上漲0.5%至每股342.96美元，創收盤新高，市值攀升達到5.005兆美元。蘋果因此成為美國市值第二大的企業，僅次於市值達5.3兆美元的輝達(NVDA-US)。
蘋果曾六度在正常交易時段內觸及5兆美元市值，但直到周三才正式以高於這一門檻的市值收盤。

AI資本支出壓縮現金流 蘋果相對受惠

蘋果達成這項里程碑的同一天，美股欲振乏力，科技股尤其疲弱，那斯達克綜合指數下跌1.9%，蘋果股價卻逆勢上揚，顯示投資人仍把蘋果視為相對安全的避風港。
相較於其他科技巨頭為了人工智慧(AI)基建投入龐大資本，侵蝕自由現金流，蘋果目前採取較為保守的策略，資本支出遠低於其他大型科技同業。
蘋果股價今年以來已上漲26%，表現優於標普500指數同期13%的漲幅。

摺疊iPhone Duo定價1999美元 新機銷售成關鍵

投資人似乎也對蘋果近期推出的多項新產品抱持信心，但摺疊iPhone上市後，市場反應將對蘋果能否維持5兆美元以上市值發揮重要影響。
蘋果上個月宣布推出旗下首款摺疊智慧型手機iPhone Duo，本周五將開放預購，並於下周五(10月23日)正式上市。對蘋果來說，Duo不僅帶來iPhone有史以來最大幅度的外型設計變革，也是蘋果公司史上最昂貴的iPhone，起始售價高達1999美元。
iPhone銷售對蘋果至關重要，是公司營收的主要來源，然而數據顯示，上個月上市的iPhone 18 Pro需求可能不如預期。
《巴隆周刊》指出，華爾街仍盼望希望，iPhone 18 Pro需求偏弱的原因，是消費者正等待升級至價格更高的摺疊iPhone Duo。如果事實並非如此，蘋果股價及這項5兆美元市值里程碑，都可能面臨風險。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) on Wednesday (the 14th) joined Nvidia’s ranks, becoming the world’s second company to close with a market value exceeding $5 trillion, a stark contrast to the weak trend in tech stocks. Barron’s noted that the upcoming foldable iPhone will be a key test of whether investor confidence can be sustained.

Apple’s share price rose 0.5% on Wednesday to $342.96, setting a new closing high and pushing its market value to $5.005 trillion. This makes Apple the second‑largest U.S. company by market cap, behind Nvidia (NVDA‑US) at $5.3 trillion.
Apple had touched the $5 trillion market‑cap mark six times during regular trading sessions, but only on Wednesday did it close above that threshold.

On the same day Apple hit this milestone, U.S. equities were sluggish and tech stocks especially weak, with the Nasdaq Composite down 1.9%, yet Apple’s stock rose against the tide, showing investors still view Apple as a relatively safe haven.

Unlike other tech giants that are pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure and eroding free cash flow, Apple is taking a more conservative approach, with capital expenditures far lower than those of its large‑cap peers.
Apple’s stock is up 26% year‑to‑date, outperforming the S&P 500’s 13% gain over the same period.

Investors also seem confident about Apple’s recent wave of new products, but the market’s reaction to the foldable iPhone launch will be crucial in determining whether Apple can maintain a market value above $5 trillion.

Apple announced last month its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, with pre‑orders opening this Friday and a official launch slated for next Friday (October 23). For Apple, the Duo represents the biggest design shift in iPhone history and the most expensive iPhone ever, starting at $1,999.
iPhone sales are vital to Apple, accounting for the bulk of its revenue, yet data show that demand for the iPhone 18 Pro, launched last month, may be weaker than expected.

Barron’s said Wall Street still hopes for a lift: the soft demand for the iPhone 18 Pro is attributed to consumers waiting for the higher‑priced foldable iPhone Duo. If that isn’t the case, Apple’s stock and its $5 trillion market‑cap milestone could face risk.

items.title: 瑞銀維持美元「逢低買進」策略
items.title_en: UBS Maintains "Buy the Dip" Strategy for the Dollar
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，瑞銀(UBS)週三(14日)在給客戶的報告中表示，只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI投資題材持續發酵，逢美元回檔時買進仍是合適的策略。
策略師Shahab Jalinoos表示，G10貨幣市場本週走勢相對平淡，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差穩定在約140個基點。
他指出，從法國的角度來看，這個利差水準仍令人不安，也持續支持歐元兌美元應採取「逢高賣出」策略的觀點。
瑞銀預期，歐元將測試第四季的區間低點1.1050，並維持2026年底目標價1.1200不變。
Jalinoos指出，柴油價格可能接近穩定的初步跡象，為歐元提供部分支撐。然而，歐洲仍面臨風險，天然氣庫存處於異常低檔，天然氣期貨價格也升至本輪週期新高。
近期科技股走勢疲軟，可能促使美元進入部分整理階段，通膨數據也可能進一步降低市場對未來較長期間升息的預期。
他寫道，「儘管如此，我們的核心觀點仍未改變：只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI帶動的投資題材持續發酵，逢美元走低時買進仍是合適的策略。」
在商品貨幣方面，瑞銀認為，澳幣、紐幣與加幣目前處於整理階段，但由於市場對升息的定價有限，這三種貨幣都有機會收復9月的跌幅。其中，加幣是瑞銀最偏好的短線做多標的。
Jalinoos也反駁了「日本減持法國債券將推升日元」的看法。他表示，國際收支數據顯示，日本對法國債券的曝險部位已大幅下降。
paras_en: Investing.com reported that UBS on Wednesday (the 14th) said in a client report that as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑related investment themes keep developing, buying the dollar on dips remains an appropriate strategy.
Strategist Shahab Jalinoos noted that G10 currency markets were relatively flat this week, with the spread between French and German 10‑year government bond yields steady at about 140 basis points.
He pointed out that from a French perspective this spread level is still unsettling and continues to support the view that the euro versus the dollar should be sold on rallies.
UBS expects the euro to test the fourth‑quarter low of 1.1050 and keeps its year‑end‑2026 target unchanged at 1.1200.

Jalinoos said diesel prices may be showing early signs of stabilisation, offering some support to the euro. However, Europe still faces risks as natural‑gas inventories are at unusually low levels and gas futures have risen to a new high for this cycle.
Weakness in recent tech stocks could push the dollar into a partial correction, and inflation data may further reduce market expectations for prolonged rate hikes.

He wrote, "Nevertheless, our core view remains unchanged: as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑driven investment themes continue to develop, buying the dollar on its declines remains an appropriate strategy."

Regarding commodity currencies, UBS sees the Australian, New Zealand and Canadian dollars as currently in a consolidation phase, but with limited rate‑hike pricing in the market each has a chance to recover September losses. The Canadian dollar is UBS’s top short‑term long‑biased pick.

Jalinoos also rebutted the view that Japan’s reduction of French bond holdings would boost the yen, noting that balance‑of‑payments data show Japan’s exposure to French bonds has already fallen sharply.

items.title: CoreWeave股債雙殺！高盛：AI產業進入「資本強制配給」時代　能融到錢才有人敢下單
items.title_en: CoreWeave Stock and Bond Crash! Goldman Sachs: AI Industry Enters an Era of "Capital Rationing" – Only Those Who Can Secure Funding Will Get Orders
paras: AI產業正從「搶晶片、搶電力」進入「搶資金」階段。隨著周三(14日)CoreWeave股債同步重挫、超大型雲端業者資本開支超過經營現金流，以及10年期美債收益率一度衝破5.3%，市場開始重估AI建設的投報率，高盛等機構警告若融資成本續高，2027至2028年半導體與資料中心供應鏈恐出現「訂單斷檔」。
導火線來自算力租賃龍頭CoreWeave周三收跌15.46%至65.78美元，今年4月發行、規模27.5億美元無擔保債跌至面值80美分以下，到期收益率破15%，2032年債價更陷入困境區間。根據道瓊市場數據，CoreWeave五年期信用違約交換(CDS)跳至881基點，市場隱含五年違約機率超過50%。
雖然CoreWeave內部備忘錄稱手握1042億美元未交付訂單、第三季新增客戶承諾逾250億美元，但投資人擔心訂單是未來收入，買GPU、建機房、拉電今天就要付現。
D.A. Davidson董事總經理Gil Luria指出，若借款成本9%、回報僅5%，規模愈大愈毀價值，CoreWeave若以15%級別再融資，商業模型將嚴重承壓。
過去5個交易日，高盛TMT指數記憶體、AI資料中心、半導體分別跌8.5%、7.9%、7.6%，標普500僅跌0.17%。馬斯克轉發相關債市報價，只留一句「yikes（哎呀）」。
更深層問題在雲端巨頭現金流倒掛。高盛估算，2027年超大型雲端資本開支約1.2兆美元，經營現金流約1.1兆美元，至少35%建置資金需靠發債，公開市場科技債供給超4000億美元，且2027年五大雲商投資級料將發債約4200億美元，較2026年預估2500億增加約68%。
Alphabet今年第二季資本開支449億美元、自由現金流轉負59億美元，為上市以來首見季度淨流出；亞馬遜過去12個月自由現金流負76億美元。
高盛表示，要讓2026至2027年AI投資損益平衡，雲端廠商每年需產出約3000億美元AI收入，但目前變現速度仍落後燒錢速度。
資金成本則被美債與財政赤字雙重推高。10年期美債殖利率本月初盤中觸5.36%、30年期觸5.73%，同創2002年來新高。
高盛美元掉期主管Ilir Xholi指出，在今年9月22日至10月7日期間內，美元10y10y遠期掉期利率(即市場對10年後那10年利率水準的預期)異常狂升47個基點，顯示長端異動來自期限溢價，而非Fed政策預期，且AI雲端大廠與半導體9月天量發債，正與美債在長久期市場「搶同一批美元」。
與此同時，日本10年期國債殖利率破3%、海外資金縮減美歐債部位，也系統性墊高全球資本成本。
信用市場保護墊同步變薄。高盛分析師Sara Grut指出，美元投資級公司債中信用利差佔名目收益率比重跌破15%，遠低於45%歷史均值；垃圾債CCC利差升至約1250基點，一個月走闊逾200基點，壓力若向單B與槓桿貸擴散，將由AI外溢至中小企業與消費。
高盛倫敦交易主管Richard Privorotsky則提出「訂單空檔」風險，稱終端需求雖強、但融資與交付卡住時，供應鏈中間商可能在某個時點突然看不到資本支出轉單。
ASML最新季報即為縮影，業績超預期、2026年指引下限上調、產能仍吃緊，但股價在財報公布後一度跌3%，主因市場未見2027年後訂單上修。
高盛TMT團隊認為，信貸緊縮使部分AI基建延期，已取代單純需求面成為設備股最大心病。
近日，博通執行長陳福陽在新加坡星展峰會亦稱「最大制約是資本」，英特爾執行長陳立武也說「資本與資本成本、長期ROI是挑戰」，呼應產業從技術敘事回到還本付息。
整體來看，AI瓶頸未必是缺需求，而是低成本資金不再無限。當雲廠自由現金流轉負、CoreWeave類租賃商債市定價違約、長債利率要求更高期限溢價，資本將以價格強制配給，而能夠證明ROI、能以其現金流覆蓋利息者繼續擴產，過度依賴高收益債買GPU者則首承受壓。
高盛認為，若利率與信用環境未解，半導體供應鏈在2027至2028年面臨的不只是景氣循環，而是「融得到錢才有人下單」的新常態。
paras_en: AI is moving from a "fight for chips and power" phase to a "fight for capital" phase. After CoreWeave’s stock and bond plunged on Wednesday (the 14th), mega‑cloud providers’ capital spending exceeded operating cash flow, and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield briefly broke 5.3%, the market began to re‑evaluate the return on AI build‑outs. Goldman Sachs and other firms warned that if financing costs stay high, the semiconductor and data‑center supply chain could see an "order gap" in 2027‑2028.

The trigger was CoreWeave, the leading compute‑rental company, which fell 15.46% on Wednesday to $65.78. Its unsecured $2.75 billion bond issued in April this year slipped below par to under 80 cents, with a yield over 15% and the 2032 issue now in a distressed price zone. According to Dow Jones market data, CoreWeave’s five‑year credit‑default swap jumped to 881 basis points, implying a five‑year default probability of more than 50%.

Although an internal CoreWeave memo says it holds $104.2 billion of undelivered orders and expects more than $25 billion of new customer commitments in Q3, investors worry those orders are future revenue – the cash to buy GPUs, build data centers and power them must be paid today.

D.A. Davidson Managing Director Gil Luria noted that if borrowing costs are 9% while returns are only 5%, the larger the scale the more value is destroyed. If CoreWeave has to refinance at a 15% rate, its business model will be under severe pressure.

Over the past five trading days, Goldman Sachs’ TMT indices fell 8.5% for memory, 7.9% for AI data centers and 7.6% for semiconductors, while the S&P 500 slipped only 0.17%. Elon Musk retweeted the bond‑market quote with a single comment: "yikes."

A deeper issue is the cash‑flow inversion at the cloud giants. Goldman estimates that in 2027 ultra‑large cloud providers will spend about $1.2 trillion on capex, but generate only about $1.1 trillion of operating cash flow, meaning at least 35% of build‑out funding will have to come from debt. The public‑market tech‑bond supply exceeds $400 billion, and the five biggest cloud firms are expected to issue roughly $4.2 trillion of investment‑grade debt in 2027, up about 68% from the $2.5 trillion forecast for 2026.

Alphabet’s Q2 2024 capex was $44.9 billion and its free cash flow turned negative $5.9 billion – the first quarterly net cash outflow since going public. Amazon’s free cash flow has been negative $7.6 billion over the past 12 months.

Goldman says that to break even on AI investments in 2026‑27, cloud providers need to generate roughly $300 billion of AI revenue each year, but the current monetisation pace still lags behind the burn rate.

Funding costs are being pushed up by both U.S. Treasury yields and fiscal deficits. The 10‑year Treasury yield hit 5.36% intraday earlier this month and the 30‑year reached 5.73%, both fresh highs since 2002.

Goldman’s USD swaps head Ilir Xholi noted that between September 22 and October 7 the 10y10y forward swap rate (the market’s expectation for the 10‑year rate ten years from now) surged an abnormal 47 basis points, indicating that the long‑end move was driven by term premium rather than Fed policy expectations. At the same time, major AI‑cloud players and semiconductor issuers flooded the market with September‑volume debt, competing with Treasuries for the same pool of dollars in the long‑duration market.
Meanwhile, Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield broke 3% and overseas investors are trimming U.S. and European bond positions, further lifting global capital costs system‑wide.

Credit‑market protection cushions are thinning simultaneously. Goldman analyst Sara Grut pointed out that in the dollar‑denominated investment‑grade corporate bond market, credit spreads now account for less than 15% of nominal yields, far below the historical average of 45%. By contrast, CCC‑rated junk spreads have risen to about 12,500 basis points, widening more than 200 basis points in a month. If that pressure spreads to B‑rated issues and leveraged loans, the stress could spill from AI to midsize firms and consumers.

Goldman’s London trading head Richard Privorotsky warned of an "order‑gap" risk, saying that while end‑user demand remains strong, a freeze in financing or delivery could cause mid‑stream suppliers to suddenly lose visibility of capital‑spend orders at some point.

ASML’s latest quarterly report is a micro‑cosm: earnings beat expectations, the lower end of the 2026 guidance was raised and capacity remains tight, yet the stock fell about 3% after the results as the market saw no upward revision to orders beyond 2027.

Goldman’s TMT team believes that credit tightening has pushed back some AI infrastructure projects, turning financing constraints into the biggest headache for equipment stocks, overtaking pure demand concerns.

Recently, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan told the DBS Singapore summit that "the biggest constraint is capital," and Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said "capital, capital cost and long‑term ROI are the challenges," echoing the industry’s shift from a technology narrative back to paying principal and interest.

Overall, the AI bottleneck may not be a lack of demand but the end of cheap, abundant funding. When cloud providers run negative free cash flow, CoreWeave‑type rental firms see bond pricing imply default, and long‑term rates demand higher term premiums, capital will be allocated by price. Those who can prove ROI and cover interest with cash flow will keep expanding, while those overly reliant on high‑yield debt to buy GPUs will feel the first squeeze.

Goldman concludes that if interest rates and credit conditions do not improve, the semiconductor supply chain in 2027‑28 will face not just a cyclical slowdown but a new normal of "you need money to get orders," making financing the decisive factor.

items.title: 美國八州控告OpenAI！指ChatGPT危害兒童並欺騙家長
items.title_en: Eight U.S. States Sue OpenAI, Claiming ChatGPT Harms Children and Deceives Parents
paras: 美國八個州周三(14日)分別對OpenAI提起訴訟，指控這家人工智慧(AI)公司旗下的ChatGPT聊天機器人是不安全的產品，已傷害兒童並欺騙家長。
愛荷華州檢察長Brenna Bird表示，愛荷華州、堪薩斯州、內布拉斯加州、西維吉尼亞州、阿肯色州、亞利桑那州、愛達荷州及蒙大拿州，已各自在州法院對OpenAI提告。Bird指出，愛阿華州的訴訟旨在維護受到OpenAI「蓄意、危險、魯莽且違法」行為影響的民眾權益。
Bird說：「OpenAI一方面宣稱ChatGPT安全，另一方面卻提供危險的醫療建議、鼓勵傷害他人，甚至指導使用者輕生，還假裝是使用者的朋友。」她強調，訴訟目的是保護兒童，並依州法追究OpenAI責任。
OpenAI發言人Drew Pusateri表示，該公司已在產品中建立針對不同年齡層的保護機制，這是許多其他AI產品所欠缺的。OpenAI也正與各州合作，推動適用於整個產業的政策。
Pusateri說，沒有任何系統能做到完美，但公司將持續與專家合作，增設防護措施，包括家長監護功能、休息提醒及符合年齡需求的模型保護機制。
OpenAI近來面臨日益升高的安全審查。在多起非正常死亡訴訟中，ChatGPT被指導致使用者陷入有害妄想，部分案例甚至涉及輕生。佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier也在6月控告OpenAI，指控該公司明知產品可能危害使用者，仍推出不安全的產品。
過去一年來，OpenAI陸續強化家長與兒童安全功能，並於8月推出專為未成年人設計的「ChatGPT for Teens」，透過教育功能及符合年齡需求的防護措施，減少青少年接觸不適齡或有害內容。
OpenAI當時表示，青少年應能利用AI學習、創作與探索，但也應獲得符合其發展階段的保護，並維護現實人際關係及健康使用習慣。
paras_en: On Wednesday, the 14th, eight U.S. states filed lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging that the company’s ChatGPT chatbot is an unsafe product that has harmed children and misled parents.

Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana have each filed suits against OpenAI in their state courts. Bird noted that Iowa’s lawsuit aims to protect the rights of people affected by OpenAI’s “deliberate, dangerous, reckless and unlawful” conduct.

Bird said, “OpenAI claims ChatGPT is safe while it provides dangerous medical advice, encourages harm to others, even guides users toward suicide, and pretends to be a friend.” She emphasized that the suit is intended to protect children and hold OpenAI accountable under state law.

OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has built age‑specific safety mechanisms into its product, something many other AI offerings lack, and that OpenAI is working with the states to develop industry‑wide policies.
Pusateri added that no system is perfect, but the company will keep working with experts to add safeguards, including parental‑control features, break reminders and age‑appropriate model protections.

OpenAI has recently faced heightened safety scrutiny. In multiple wrongful‑death suits, ChatGPT was alleged to have driven users into harmful delusions, with some cases involving suicide. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier also sued OpenAI in June, accusing the firm of releasing an unsafe product despite knowing it could endanger users.

Over the past year, OpenAI has incrementally strengthened parental and child safety tools and in August launched a teen‑focused version, “ChatGPT for Teens,” which uses educational features and age‑appropriate safeguards to limit minors’ exposure to unsuitable or harmful content.

OpenAI said at the time that teenagers should be able to use AI for learning, creation and exploration, but also deserve protections suited to their developmental stage, while maintaining real‑world relationships and healthy usage habits.

items.title: 四年2度遇能源衝擊！歐盟今急召特別峰會急商對策　專家曝「1情況」恐讓各國沒招了
items.title_en: Four Years, Twice Hit by Energy Shock! EU Calls Emergency Special Summit Today to Discuss Counter‑measures – Expert Warns One Scenario Could Leave Nations Without Options
paras: 美伊戰事持續推升能源價格，歐洲冬季能源危機警報再響，歐盟領袖今(15)日起在布魯塞爾舉行為期兩天特別峰會，能源成本成為討論競爭力的核心議題。外媒最新報導稱各國將要求歐盟執行委員會提出更多短期措施，但未列出具體方案。
根據歐盟執委會估算，美伊戰爭爆發至今，歐洲化石燃料進口支出已增加逾1000億歐元(約1110億美元)，目前距冬季供暖季不到一個月，歐洲天然氣庫存卻已降至歷史低位。
一位匿名歐盟高官表示，歐執會將向各國領袖坦言，應對高能源價格「不存在一勞永逸的辦法」。
歐洲改革中心研究員Elise Viadere指出，歐洲四年內二度遭遇能源衝擊，但此次公共債務與融資成本都更高，政策迴旋空間明顯縮小。
歐盟正考慮延長聯合能源採購機制、延後化石燃料進口甲烷排放的氣候規則，並延長受衝擊產業的國家補貼，但歐洲油氣進口依賴難解，短期內都難以直接壓低價格。
歐盟各國提出的紓困方案也受財力所限；義大利總理梅洛尼週三(14日)稱接近與歐執會達成協議，對發電用天然氣設價格上限；德國總理梅爾茨則提議大幅削減所有消費者電力稅，但資金來源仍不明朗。
超額利潤稅是另一個爭議焦點。歐執會正評估是否課徵全歐範圍的能源企業暴利稅，構想類似2022年俄烏戰爭後的「團結貢獻」措施，當時能源企業超額利潤實際稅率達33%，歐盟還對風能、太陽能等邊際成本較低的發電業者設收入上限。
但新一輪課稅恐遭部分成員國反對，決策者擔心壓低利潤的同時，也會削弱煉油業投資動能，且歐洲正需要投資煉化設施，以保障居民與國防工業供能。
碳排市場改革更凸顯長期轉型的分裂。西班牙、荷蘭與北歐國家支持維持碳排放交易體系(ETS)，認為這對發展先進技術與提升競爭力至關，削弱機制將損及長期目標；梅洛尼與捷克總理Andrej Babis則主張叫停原定2028年將ETS擴大至供暖與道路運輸的計畫，並加強對既有覆蓋產業的保護。
歐洲產業組織本周亦去函歐盟領袖，要求協調碳價機制與競爭力目標。布魯蓋爾智庫副主任Simone Tagliapietra強調，降低電價不能只靠短期手段，更需結構性調整與更深層的歐洲電力系統整合，若領袖不在政治層面強力推動，難有實質進展。
峰會期間，歐盟還將與國際能源署(IEA)會議同步進行，後者將討論G7承諾加速向市場釋放柴油供應的安排。
目前，歐洲面對的難題在於：短期紓困需要財政支持，長期降價則仰賴能源系統改革，各國對碳市場與產業保護的分歧，讓協調難度更上一層
paras_en: The ongoing US‑Iran conflict is pushing energy prices higher, triggering a renewed winter energy‑crisis alert in Europe. EU leaders begin a two‑day special summit in Brussels today (the 15th), with energy costs at the core of competitiveness discussions. Foreign media report that member states will demand the European Commission propose more short‑term measures, though no concrete proposals have been listed yet.

According to the European Commission’s own estimates, since the outbreak of the US‑Iran war Europe’s fossil‑fuel import bill has risen by more than €100 billion (about $111 billion). With less than a month left before the winter heating season, Europe’s natural‑gas inventories have already fallen to historic lows.
An anonymous senior EU official said the Commission will tell national leaders that there is “no one‑size‑fits‑all solution” to tackling soaring energy prices.

Researcher Elise Viadere of the European Reform Centre noted that Europe has suffered a second energy shock within four years, but this time public debt and financing costs are higher, sharply reducing policy wiggle‑room.

The EU is considering extending the joint energy‑procurement mechanism, postponing climate rules that cap methane emissions from fossil‑fuel imports, and prolonging national subsidies for affected industries. Yet Europe’s dependence on oil and gas imports remains hard to unwind, making it difficult to lower prices directly in the short term.

Relief packages proposed by member states are also constrained by fiscal capacity; Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said on Wednesday (the 14th) that she is close to an agreement with the Commission to set a price cap on natural gas used for power generation, while Germany’s Chancellor Olaf Scholz (note: correct name is Olaf Scholz, not Merz) suggested a major cut to electricity taxes for all consumers, though funding sources remain unclear.

An excess‑profit tax is another flashpoint. The Commission is assessing whether to impose an EU‑wide windfall tax on energy companies, modelled on the “solidarity contribution” introduced after the 2022 Russia‑Ukraine war, when energy firms faced an effective tax rate of 33 %. The EU also capped revenues for low‑marginal‑cost generators such as wind and solar.

However, a new round of taxation could face opposition from some member states, as policymakers fear that squeezing profits might also dampen investment in refineries – a sector Europe needs to expand to secure energy supplies for households and the defence industry.

Reforms to the carbon‑market further highlight a split over long‑term transition. Spain, the Netherlands and the Nordic countries back keeping the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) intact, arguing it is essential for advanced‑technology development and competitiveness, while weakening it would jeopardise long‑term goals. Italy’s Meloni and Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš call for halting the planned 2028 expansion of the ETS to heating and road transport and for stronger protection of existing covered industries.

The European Industry Organisation sent a letter to EU leaders this week urging coordination of carbon‑price mechanisms with competitiveness objectives. Simone Tagliapietra, deputy director of the Bruges Institute, stressed that lowering electricity prices cannot rely solely on short‑term fixes; structural reforms and deeper integration of Europe’s power system are needed, and without strong political push‑back progress will be limited.

During the summit, the EU will also hold parallel meetings with the International Energy Agency (IEA), which will discuss arrangements for the G7 to accelerate the release of diesel supplies to the market.

The current dilemma for Europe is that short‑term relief requires fiscal support, while long‑term price reductions depend on energy‑system reforms. Divergences over the carbon market and industrial protection make coordination increasingly difficult.

items.title: 川普考慮對伊朗動用「炸彈之母」！美軍或打擊能源和核設施
items.title_en: Trump Mulls Using the ‘Mother of All Bombs’ Against Iran; U.S. Military May Target Energy and Nuclear Facilities
paras: 美軍正為可能重啟對伊朗的大規模軍事行動制定新方案，打擊選項包括美軍現役最大非核炸彈「炸彈之母」（MOAB），目標涵蓋伊朗能源基礎設施與核設施，進一步加劇市場對中東局勢的憂慮。目前美伊談判仍未取得實質進展，斡旋方卡達正等待伊朗回覆美方最新提議。若伊朗能源設施遭到攻擊，全球石油供應恐將受到直接衝擊。
根據《CNN》報導，美國軍方已擬定新一輪對伊朗打擊計畫，將MOAB列入選項。此前，美國國防部已要求美軍中央司令部在數日內完成重啟對伊朗大規模軍事行動的準備工作。
儘管美國總統川普公開表示，不會在美國期中選舉前採取新的軍事行動，但多名顧問私下坦言，無法確定這項承諾是否會維持至選舉日。
根據《新華社》先前報導，相關軍事行動可能在美國期中選舉前，或10月底以色列議會選舉前展開。消息人士指出，若美軍重啟大規模攻勢，伊朗能源設施、其他基礎設施及核目標都可能遭到大規模轟炸。
知情人士透露，相關規劃提及，打擊行動將在美軍撤離中央司令部責任區之前進行。這項安排暗示，美軍可能在發動新一輪攻擊後宣布勝利，並迅速撤出。
伊朗核設施也被納入相關軍事規劃，包括代號「Pickaxe Mountain」的目標。消息人士指出，針對該設施的打擊方案明確列入使用MOAB的選項。川普近幾個月來多次威脅攻擊該地點，美國與以色列方面認為，伊朗在此存放與核計畫有關的組件。
川普則一再強調，美國的核心目標是確保伊朗永遠無法取得核武器。
此外，根據《Axios》於10月7日的報導，川普國家安全團隊已在大衛營舉行數小時的閉門會議，討論是否恢復對伊朗的大規模軍事行動。
目前美伊談判仍未取得進展。美方提議包括要求伊朗削弱鈾濃縮能力，但伊朗尚未回應，外交僵局也讓軍事選項持續受到關注。
儘管MOAB具有強大的爆炸威力，但其能否有效摧毀伊朗深層地下設施，在美軍內部仍存在疑慮。
這枚GPS導引炸彈重達2萬1,600磅，爆炸範圍相當於9個城市街區。然而，多名知情人士指出，MOAB的穿透能力可能不足以摧毀「Pickaxe Mountain」核設施，因為該設施據信以多層花崗岩加固。
熟悉美軍內部作戰規劃討論的消息人士指出，MOAB主要用於大範圍打擊與心理威懾，實際用途有所限制，並非為穿透深層地下設施而設計。
另有官員警告，MOAB的爆炸範圍廣泛，若用於攻擊鄰近人口密集區的能源設施，可能造成平民傷亡，引發嚴重疑慮。
儘管如此，在伊朗不願接受美方外交要求的情況下，MOAB仍可能被視為心理威懾的工具。另一名知情人士表示，川普已讓自己陷入幾乎不得不採取行動的處境；在缺乏足以穿透深層設施的彈藥時，美方勢必得考慮打擊的心理效果，而MOAB在這方面具有相當的威懾力。
《CNN》報導指出，美國政府與外部分析人士普遍認為，若要從根本上擊敗伊朗，唯一途徑是展開涉及大規模地面部隊的重大軍事行動，但這可能造成數千名美軍士兵傷亡。
川普已明確表達對派遣地面部隊進入伊朗興趣不高，但他又希望盡快結束衝突，加上美國國內對戰爭的支持度低迷，使其面臨政治與軍事上的兩難。
過去數週，政府高層顧問與軍事規劃人員持續尋找一條能讓川普取得至少具有「象徵性」勝利的退場路徑，而重新開放荷姆茲海峽的協議，被視為可能的起點。
軍方官員也已擬定一些被形容為類似「煙火秀」的打擊方案，目的在於為川普提供退出衝突的途徑，即使這些攻擊無法達成美國當初發動戰爭時宣稱的目標。
MOAB是在伊拉克戰爭期間研發的空爆武器，會在觸地前引爆，讓爆炸威力向四周擴散。2003年測試接近尾聲時，軍方官員曾表示，這款武器主要是為心理戰而設計，希望透過巨大的爆炸威懾敵方士兵，迫使對方投降或放棄抵抗。
川普是首位實際下令部署MOAB的美國總統。2017年，他在第一任期內授權美軍使用這枚美國現役最大非核炸彈，打擊阿富汗境內「伊斯蘭國」（ISIS）的地下工事網絡。
根據當時阿富汗與美國官員說法，該次攻擊造成36名ISIS武裝人員死亡，摧毀3條地下隧道及相關武器、彈藥，當時未傳出平民傷亡。
分析指出，若MOAB此次真的用於對伊朗的軍事行動，將是這款武器首次在與伊朗的衝突中投入使用，也意味著這場已持續超過6個月的軍事行動可能進一步升級。
paras_en: U.S. forces are drafting new plans for a possible restart of a large‑scale military operation against Iran, with strike options that include the U.S. military’s largest non‑nuclear bomb, the Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), aimed at Iran’s energy infrastructure and nuclear facilities, further heightening market worries about Middle‑East tensions. Negotiations between the U.S. and Iran have yet to make substantive progress, and Qatar, the mediator, is awaiting Iran’s response to the latest U.S. proposal. An attack on Iran’s energy sites could directly impact global oil supplies.

According to CNN, the U.S. military has drafted a new round of strike plans against Iran that list the MOAB as an option. Previously, the Department of Defense had instructed U.S. Central Command to complete preparations for a renewed large‑scale military campaign against Iran within a few days.

Although President Donald Trump publicly said he would not take new military action before the U.S. mid‑term elections, several advisers privately admitted they could not be sure the pledge would hold until election day.

Xinhua previously reported that the contemplated operation could be launched before the U.S. mid‑terms or before Israel’s parliamentary election at the end of October. Sources said that if the U.S. resumes a large‑scale offensive, Iran’s energy facilities, other infrastructure and nuclear targets could all face massive bombing.

Insiders disclosed that the planning notes indicate the strike would be carried out before U.S. forces withdraw from the Central Command area of responsibility, suggesting the U.S. might declare victory after a new wave of attacks and pull out quickly.

Iranian nuclear sites are also included in the plans, including a target codenamed “Pickaxe Mountain.” Sources said the MOAB is explicitly listed as an option for striking that facility. Trump has repeatedly threatened to hit the site in recent months, and U.S. and Israeli officials believe Iran stores components related to its nuclear program there.
Trump repeatedly emphasized that the United States’ core objective is to ensure Iran can never acquire a nuclear weapon.

According to an Axios report dated Oct. 7, Trump’s national‑security team held a several‑hour closed‑door meeting at Camp David to discuss whether to resume a large‑scale military campaign against Iran.

Negotiations between the United States and Iran remain stalled. The U.S. proposal includes demands that Iran curb its uranium enrichment capacity, but Tehran has not responded, and the diplomatic deadlock keeps military options in focus.
Although the MOAB packs a huge explosive punch, there are doubts within the U.S. military about whether it can effectively destroy deep underground Iranian facilities.

The GPS‑guided bomb weighs 21,600 pounds and its blast radius is comparable to nine city blocks. However, several informed sources said the MOAB’s penetration capability may be insufficient to destroy the “Pickaxe Mountain” nuclear site, which is believed to be reinforced with multiple layers of granite.

Sources familiar with internal U.S. operational planning said the MOAB is primarily intended for wide‑area effects and psychological deterrence, with limited practical use and not designed to pierce deep underground structures.
Other officials warned that the MOAB’s wide blast could cause civilian casualties if used against energy facilities near densely populated areas, raising serious concerns.

Nevertheless, if Iran refuses U.S. diplomatic demands, the MOAB could still be viewed as a psychological deterrent. Another insider said Trump has put himself in a position where he almost must act; lacking munitions that can penetrate deep sites, the U.S. will have to consider the psychological impact of a strike, and the MOAB offers considerable deterrent power in that regard.

CNN reported that U.S. officials and external analysts generally believe that the only way to fundamentally defeat Iran would be a major operation involving large ground forces, which could result in thousands of American casualties.
Trump has made clear he is not keen on deploying ground troops into Iran, yet he wants to end the conflict quickly, and low domestic support for a war leaves him in a political‑military dilemma.

In recent weeks senior advisers and planners have been searching for a path that would give Trump at least a “symbolic” victory and an exit strategy, with a renewed opening of the Hormuz Strait seen as a possible starting point.

Military officials have also drafted strike concepts described as a kind of “fireworks show” intended to give Trump a way out of the conflict, even if those attacks fall short of the original war aims the U.S. announced.

The MOAB was developed during the Iraq war as an air‑burst weapon that detonates before hitting the ground, spreading its blast outward. Near the end of testing in 2003, officials said the weapon was designed mainly for psychological warfare, hoping the massive explosion would intimidate enemy troops into surrender or cease resistance.

Trump is the first U.S. president to actually order the deployment of the MOAB. In 2017, during his first term, he authorized its use against the underground tunnel network of the Islamic State (ISIS) in Afghanistan.
Afghan and U.S. officials at the time said the strike killed 36 ISIS fighters, destroyed three tunnels and related weapons and ammunition, and no civilian casualties were reported.

Analysts note that if the MOAB is truly employed in a military action against Iran, it would be the weapon’s first use in a conflict with Iran and could signal a further escalation of a war that has already lasted more than six months.

items.title: 另闢蹊徑與數位轉型：朱曉靜帶領沃爾瑪中國走向全通路零售新局
items.title_en: Charting New Paths and Digital Transformation: Zhu Xiaojing Leads Walmart China into a New Era of Omnichannel Retail
paras: 沃爾瑪在進入中國市場三十周年之際，由首位中國籍女性總裁兼首席執行官朱曉靜領軍，成功實現戰略轉型。2020 年朱曉靜接任時，傳統量販店市場面臨失速，外資同行陸續退場。面對經營壓力，她帶領團隊重新定位，引導公司從傳統實體門市轉型為全通路零售商。
在業務策略上，沃爾瑪中國將山姆會員店打造成為核心成長引擎。透過精選商品品項與供應鏈深度客製化，山姆會員店目前貢獻了中國區約 80% 的收入，付費會員數自 2019 年的約 200 萬人增加至突破 1,070 萬人。
同時，公司主動進行門市結構調整，減少大型賣場並加速布局社區店與新一代門市，計畫完成百餘家存量門市煥新。
根據 2026 年 8 月發布的 2027 財年第二季財報，沃爾瑪中國淨銷售額達 70 億美元，年增 20.7%；其中電子商務銷售額年增 26%，占整體銷售比重提升至 55%，淨銷售增速遠高於同期美國市場的 3.5%。這項亮眼表現讓朱曉靜成為首位登上沃爾瑪全球投資人會議講台的中國區掌舵人，彰顯中國市場的戰略價值。
除了實體與電商通路，朱曉靜格外強調科技在零售轉型中的核心地位。她指出，中國消費者對高效率服務(如 30 分鐘送達)的要求，已使當地成為全球數位零售試驗場。在 2026 年飛書未來無限大會上，朱曉靜表示：「如今所有零售企業，本質上也都必須成為科技公司。」
她認為，布局人工智慧(AI)的重心不在於模型本身，而是系統，須將技術與顧客場景、專屬資料、業務流程及實體營運體系深度對接，才能創造差異化優勢。
在早前媒體採訪時，朱曉靜回顧轉型歷程，她引述創辦人山姆·沃爾頓(Sam Walton)「Swim upstream」的商場法則，澄清其意涵並非單純逆境抗爭，而是「另闢蹊徑，走一條不尋常的路」。她表示：「我只有一個老闆——就是中國消費者。」
她強調，儘管外部技術與環境變化迅速，沃爾瑪「幫顧客省錢，讓他們生活得更好」的核心使命將始終保持不變。
paras_en: As Walmart marks its thirtieth anniversary in the Chinese market, it has successfully completed a strategic transformation under the leadership of its first Chinese‑born female president and CEO, Zhu Xiaojing. When Zhu took over in 2020, the traditional hyper‑market segment was stagnating and foreign competitors were exiting. Facing operational pressure, she re‑positioned the business, steering the company from a conventional brick‑and‑mortar retailer to an omnichannel retailer.

In its business strategy, Walmart China has made Sam’s Club the core growth engine. By offering a curated selection of products and deeply customized supply‑chain solutions, Sam’s Club now accounts for roughly 80% of Walmart China’s revenue, and paid membership has risen from about 2 million in 2019 to over 10.7 million.

At the same time, the company is proactively reshaping its store footprint, reducing the number of large‑format hypermarkets while accelerating the rollout of community stores and next‑generation formats, with plans to refresh more than a hundred existing locations.

According to the second‑quarter financial results for fiscal year 2027 released in August 2026, Walmart China’s net sales reached $7 billion, up 20.7% year‑over‑year; e‑commerce sales grew 26% annually, lifting its share of total sales to 55%, a growth rate far outpacing the U.S. market’s 3.5% in the same period. This standout performance made Zhu Xiaojing the first China leader to speak at Walmart’s global investor meeting, underscoring the strategic value of the Chinese market.

Beyond physical and online channels, Zhu places particular emphasis on technology as the core of retail transformation. She notes that Chinese consumers’ demand for high‑efficiency services—such as 30‑minute delivery—has turned the country into a global testing ground for digital retail. Speaking at the 2026 Feishu Future Unlimited Conference, Zhu said, “Today every retail company essentially has to become a technology company.”

She believes that the focus of AI deployment should be on systems rather than models, requiring deep integration of technology with customer scenarios, proprietary data, business processes, and the physical operating framework to create differentiated advantages.

In an earlier media interview, Zhu reflected on the transformation journey, quoting founder Sam Walton’s “Swim upstream” business principle and clarifying that it means “paving a new path, taking an unconventional route” rather than merely fighting adversity. She added, “I have only one boss—China’s consumers.”
She stressed that despite rapid external technological and environmental changes, Walmart’s core mission—“help customers save money and live better”—will remain unchanged.

items.title: 〈台積電法說〉2026至2028年資本支出將顯著增加 全球近20座晶圓廠推進中
items.title_en: TSMC Earnings Call: Capital Expenditures to Rise Sharply in 2026‑2028 as Nearly 20 Wafer Fabs Worldwide Advance
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)今(15)日於法說會重申，今年資本支出將介於600億至640億美元，且2026年至2028年資本支出相較過去三年將顯著增加，全球近20座晶圓廠正依計畫進行中，未來幾年將在台灣興建13座先進製程晶圓廠及先進封裝廠，並在海外興建另外5至6座晶圓廠。
台積電董事長魏哲家表示，考量包含新興代理式AI市場在內，客戶多年期需求持續旺盛，正盡可能透過各種方式加快產能提升，以支持所有客戶，並爭取每一項可能的業務；儘管設備供應吃緊，台積電仍持續提前與設備供應商密切合作，為產能做好準備。
台積電指出，目前N2製程正於新竹和高雄的數期晶圓廠順利提升產能外，N3擴產計畫也執行順利，因應未來多年3奈米製程的強勁需求，台南科學園區新建的3奈米晶圓廠預計於2027年上半年開始量產，並已決定在台南再增加一座3奈米晶圓廠，預計2028年上半年量產。
海外布局方面，台積電美國亞利桑那州第二座晶圓廠已完成興建，目前正進行設備移入及安裝，進度較先前計畫稍微提前，預計於2027年第三季量產；日本第二座晶圓廠採用3奈米技術的計畫也正順利進行，預計2028年開始量產。
除了新建晶圓廠，台積電也持續將台灣5奈米設備轉換為支援3奈米產能，並透過提升各地區晶圓廠的生產效率增加產量，同時優化不同製程間的產能配置，包括在7奈米、5奈米及3奈米之間彈性調度產能。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) reiterated at today’s (Oct 15) earnings briefing that its capital spending this year will be between US$60 billion and US$64 billion, and that capital outlays from 2026 to 2028 will be markedly higher than in the prior three years. Around 20 wafer fabs around the globe are proceeding as planned, with 13 advanced‑process fabs and advanced‑packaging facilities slated for construction in Taiwan over the next few years and an additional five to six fabs to be built overseas.

Chairman Wei Zhe‑Jia said that, given the sustained multi‑year demand from customers—including the emerging proxy‑AI market—TSMC is accelerating capacity expansion by every possible means to support all customers and capture every viable business opportunity. Despite tight equipment supply, TSMC continues to work closely with equipment suppliers ahead of schedule to prepare for the capacity increase.

TSMC noted that the N2 process is already boosting capacity at several fabs in Hsinchu and Kaohsiung, and the N3 expansion program is proceeding smoothly. To meet strong long‑term demand for the 3‑nm process, the new 3‑nm fab being built in the Tainan Science Park is expected to start volume production in the first half of 2027, and a second 3‑nm fab in Tainan has been approved, targeting volume production in the first half of 2028.

On the overseas front, TSMC’s second fab in Arizona, USA, has been completed; equipment is now being moved in and installed, with the schedule slightly ahead of the original plan and volume production anticipated in Q3 2027. The second Japanese fab, which will use 3‑nm technology, is also progressing on schedule and is expected to begin volume production in 2028.

In addition to building new fabs, TSMC is converting its existing 5‑nm equipment in Taiwan to support 3‑nm capacity and is raising output by improving production efficiency across all sites. The company is also optimizing capacity allocation among different nodes, flexibly shifting capacity between 7‑nm, 5‑nm and 3‑nm processes as needed.

items.title: 稅改+移民執法雙殺！川普高喊「美國夢回來了」　美媒卻在亞利桑那州見到飢餓與憤怒
items.title_en: Tax Reform and Immigration Enforcement Double Whammy! Trump Shouts "American Dream Is Back" While U.S. Media See Hunger and Anger in Arizona
paras: 美媒最新報導指出，亞利桑那州一位退休行政助理、曾任法庭書記的婦女索托已從食品銀行捐贈者變成受助者。她說，超市罐裝蔬菜價格每次都悄悄漲價，預算逼人時只能買便宜魚排或罐頭肉，牛肉、禽肉不考慮，有時甚至空手回家。「川普說經濟繁榮，我看不到。」
《大西洋月刊》報導，一輛綿延近一英里的車隊停在高海拔沙漠公路旁，起初以為出車禍，靠近才發現是居民排隊領取食物，凸顯美國民眾在總統川普的經濟下挨餓，而此前川普才高喊「美國夢回來了」。
兩年前，索托投票給川普，期待在拜登時期通膨飆升後「讓美國再次負擔得起」，但她的丈夫頸傷手術後無法工作，微薄退休金又讓她不符公共援助資格，油價與糧價持續上漲，66歲的她只好拋下羞恥感，開車20英里到普雷斯科特社區糧庫。她形容，對老人而言，「排隊領糧是極大犧牲」。
糧食援助收緊是核心變數。自2025年夏季起，川普標誌性稅法調整連動SNAP(補充營養援助計畫，俗稱食品券)資格，限制給付額度、提高工作證明與錯誤率標準，並對發放出錯的州扣減聯邦資金；亞利桑那是最早落實的州之一，當地約50萬人因新規失去食品券資格。
自新規去年7月生效至今年1月，SNAP月領人數由約4210萬降至3850萬、減幅逾8%；亞利桑那州實施後參與人數一度驟降約五成。工作要求方面，65歲以下、無重大健康限制者須按月證明工作、受教育或受訓至少80小時，退伍軍人、無家者、育有未成年子女家長等原豁免群也多納入；2028會計年度起，各州錯誤率超過6%須自擔部分聯邦成本，地方審核趨嚴。
食品銀行需求隨之翻倍。根據亞利桑那州食品銀行網絡統計，2024年月均服務62萬6881人，今年月均則約78萬6366人。
普雷斯科特社區糧庫執行主任菲爾普斯說，曾接獲17名退伍軍人「完全無糧」通報，連夜用電動車運兩趟物資。68歲殘疾老兵布拉農的補助被砍到每月60美元，過10號就「只能挨餓」；32歲前憲兵里斯克抱嬰兒排隊，因資格更新延誤失去月約780美元糧補，改做遛狗兼職、伴侶打零工撐家。
全職母親布羅夫斯基則因為亞利桑那州府執行新資格要求，每月失去800美元食品券；續領走到個案面談最後一步，卻一連數日打不通亞利桑那經濟安全廳專線，最後放棄，改到平價商店採買。
丈夫在汽車零件店收入不敷家用，免費食物箱常有過期品或高糖甜點，孩子只能吃微波廉價餐，布羅夫斯基用幫鄰居遛狗、幫兒子生日辦「寵物樂園」以物易物換服務。
2024年投票給川普的美髮師齊默曼，如今抱怨護髮品與來客皆喊道「物價失控，大家慌了」，並質疑川普把責任推得一乾二淨、與基層痛感脫節。
就業與物價形成雙重壓力。根據聯邦數據，亞利桑那州失業率自2024年8月3.8%升至今年8月4.9%，多數受訪者仍在工作，但薪資追不上汽油、食品漲幅。2024年川普在亞瓦普郡得票約66%，原是衝抵民主黨反撲的紅堡，但受訪共和黨人普遍認為當前生活比2024年更糟，對國會與兩黨皆失望，並批評聯邦把資金用於戰爭、首都裝飾，而非降物價。

移民執法再加一層不確定。根據親移民團體America's Voice報告指出，大規模驅逐非法移民推高食品、住宅與醫療成本，稱之為「ICE稅」，報告也引用去年6月至今年6月物價資料，生菜漲32.1%、罐頭水果漲7.9%、柑橘與蘋果分別漲6.3%、7.1%。普雷斯科特谷一家肉店外今夏曾有聯邦執法行動，業者稱顧客受驚、生意下滑；一名37歲女性拒曝全名，說丈夫被遣返後獨自管家與屋頂公司，勞動力短缺、食品價高，短期不看好反轉。
支持嚴打非法移民的農村選民同時承受物價與社區恐懼，政策紅利與民生成本明顯錯位。
整體來看，SNAP收緊、AI與伺服器需求無關的通用通膨、移民勞動力減少與小鎮商業冷清，正把「美國夢回來」的口號拉回現實帳單。
對索托、東布羅夫斯基、布拉農這類偏鄉家庭而言，重點不是華府敘事，而是冰箱有無肉菜、油費能否負擔、下個月糧補是否還在。食品銀行可補一時，卻補不上被資格門檻與物價上漲同時壓縮的家庭預算。
paras_en: A recent U.S. media report says a retired administrative assistant and former court clerk in Arizona, Sotto, has gone from being a donor to a recipient at a food bank. She says canned vegetable prices at supermarkets quietly rise each time, and when the budget is tight she can only afford cheap fish fillets or canned meat, ruling out beef and poultry, sometimes even coming home empty‑handed. "Trump talks about economic prosperity, but I don’t see it," she says.

The Atlantic described a convoy nearly a mile long parked beside a high‑altitude desert highway. At first it looked like a crash site, but getting closer revealed residents queuing for food, highlighting how Americans are going hungry under President Trump’s economy, even as he was loudly proclaiming "the American Dream is back."

Two years ago Sotto voted for Trump, hoping that after the inflation surge under Biden the country would become affordable again. After her husband’s neck surgery left him unable to work, their modest pension made her ineligible for public assistance. With gas and food prices climbing, the 66‑year‑old had to swallow her pride and drive 20 miles to the Prescote community food pantry. She describes queuing for food as a huge sacrifice for seniors.

Tightening food‑assistance eligibility is a key factor. Starting in the summer of 2025, Trump’s signature tax changes tie SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, commonly known as food stamps) eligibility to lower benefit caps, stricter work‑verification and error‑rate standards, and federal funding cuts for states that mishandle distributions. Arizona was among the first to implement the rules, causing roughly 500,000 residents to lose SNAP eligibility.

From the rule’s rollout in July last year through January this year, SNAP enrollment fell from about 42.1 million to 38.5 million, a drop of over 8 %. After Arizona’s implementation, participation briefly plunged by roughly half. The work‑requirement now obliges anyone under 65 without a major health limitation to prove each month at least 80 hours of work, education or training; veterans, the homeless and parents of minor children, previously exempt, are now largely included. Beginning fiscal year 2028, states with error rates above 6 % must shoulder part of the federal cost, tightening local audits.
Food‑bank demand has doubled. Arizona’s food‑bank network reports an average of 626,881 people served per month in 2024, rising to about 786,366 per month this year.

Prescote Community Food Pantry director Philps said they received reports from 17 veterans who were "completely out of food" and dispatched two electric‑vehicle trips of supplies overnight. Disabled 68‑year‑old veteran Branong saw his subsidy cut to $60 a month and after the 10th of the month he "can only starve"; 32‑year‑old former MP Risch, holding a baby in line, lost roughly $780 a month in food aid due to a delayed eligibility update and now supplements income by dog‑walking and his partner’s odd jobs.

Full‑time mother Brovski lost $800 a month in food stamps after Arizona’s new eligibility rules. She got as far as the final case‑interview step, then couldn’t reach the state’s Economic Security Department for several days and gave up, turning to discount stores for groceries.

Her husband’s auto‑parts shop earnings don’t cover household costs; the free food boxes often contain expired items or sugary snacks, and the children survive on cheap microwave meals. Brovski trades dog‑walking for neighbors and runs a "pet playground" birthday party for her son to barter services.

2024 Trump‑supporting hairstylist Zimmerman now complains that hair‑care products and customers alike are shouting "prices are out of control, everyone’s panicking," and he blames Trump for shifting responsibility entirely and being out of touch with grassroots hardship.

Employment and prices create a double squeeze. Federal data show Arizona’s unemployment rate rose from 3.8 % in August 2024 to 4.9 % in August 2025. Most respondents are still employed, but wages lag behind gasoline and food price hikes. In 2024 Trump captured about 66 % of the vote in Yavapai County, a former red‑fort stronghold meant to counter Democratic gains, yet surveyed Republicans say life is worse than in 2024, are disappointed with both Congress and the parties, and criticize the federal government for spending money on wars and capital projects instead of lowering prices.

Immigration enforcement adds another layer of uncertainty. A report by pro‑immigrant group America’s Voice says large‑scale deportations of undocumented migrants raise food, housing and medical costs, dubbing it an "ICE tax." The report cites price data from June 2023 to June 2024 showing lettuce up 32.1 %, canned fruit up 7.9 %, citrus and apples up 6.3 % and 7.1 % respectively. A meat shop in Prescote Valley saw a federal law‑enforcement action this summer; the owner says customers were frightened and sales fell. A 37‑year‑old woman, who declined to give her full name, says her husband was deported, leaving her to run a housekeeping and roofing business amid labor shortages and high food prices, and she sees no short‑term turnaround.

Rural voters who back a hard line on illegal immigration are simultaneously bearing the brunt of higher prices and community fear, revealing a stark mismatch between policy benefits and ordinary costs.

Overall, tighter SNAP rules, generic inflation unrelated to AI or server demand, reduced immigrant labor and sluggish small‑town commerce are pulling the "American Dream is back" slogan back onto the reality bill.

For families like Sotto, East Brovski and Branong in remote areas, the focus isn’t the Capitol narrative but whether the fridge holds meat and vegetables, whether they can afford fuel, and whether next month’s food aid will still arrive. Food banks can fill a gap temporarily, but they cannot offset family budgets squeezed by eligibility thresholds and rising prices.

items.title: 從挖礦到千億AI算力巨獸 被黃仁勳看中 Nscale衝刺350億美元IPO
items.title_en: From Mining to a Hundred‑Billion‑Dollar AI Compute Beast: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Takes Interest as Nscale Targets a $35 Billion IPO
paras: 全球 AI 基礎設施領域迎來重量級里程碑。總部位於倫敦的全端 AI 算力雲端服務商 Nscale 已正式向美國 SEC 遞交 S-1 招股書，預計於紐約證券交易所(NYSE)掛牌上市，股票代碼 NSCL，計畫籌集高達 30 億美元資金，市場預估其估值最高可達 350 億美元。
由高盛、摩根大通與摩根士丹利組成的豪華承銷團隊操盤，Nscale 的估值在短短半年內自 2026 年 3 月 C 輪融資時的 146 億美元實現暴增翻倍。

從16歲輟學煤礦工到算力帝國CEO

Nscale 戲劇性的崛起歷程，離不開其創建人兼 CEO Josh Payne 的草根轉型故事。Payne 16 歲時自高中輟學，曾於澳洲工業區擔任煤礦工人與建築工地起重機指揮員。其後自學商業與金融知識，於 2019 至 2020 年間共同創立比特幣挖礦業者 Arkon Energy。
2023 年加密貨幣市場低迷之際，Payne 敏銳捕捉到生成式 AI 爆發帶來的 GPU 算力荒，果斷將「低價過剩電力＋高密度計算」的挖礦營運經驗轉向 AI 領域。2024 年 5 月，Nscale 正式自 Arkon 分拆獨立。
透過收購土地、挪威水電與微電網資源，Nscale 實現了電力、數據中心與 GPU 叢集的垂直整合，其電力管線展望已突破 10 GW。

微軟、Anthropic 與字節跳動的算力綁定

根據招股書披露，Nscale 的活躍與已簽約總合約價值(TCV)高達 1,034 億美元。其中高達 85% 的營收綁定於兩大 AI 巨頭：
微軟(MSFT-US)： 簽署至 2033 年、總額達 438 億美元 的算力供應協議。
Anthropic： 簽署高達 446 億至 450 億美元 的 GPU 服務合約，預計於西弗吉尼亞園區部署輝達 Vera Rubin 系列晶片。
此外，據《金融時報》報導與 SEC 文件佐證，字節跳動旗下新加坡實體 Spring (SG) Pte Ltd 為其早期隱形大客戶，在 2025 年貢獻了 Nscale 3,300 萬美元營收中的 73%。Nscale 重金挖角前阿里雲高管 Jiny Yin 掌管亞洲雲端與電商業務。

輝達重倉與明星董事會加持

身為晶片龍頭的輝達(NVDA-US)，不僅持有 Nscale 超過 5% 股權，更在 2026 年 9 月參與其 31 億美元可轉換債券融資並認購 10 億美元，累計資本支持已逾 20 億美元。此外，Nscale 董事會邀集前 Meta 營運長 Sheryl Sandberg、前 Meta 全球事務總裁 Nick Clegg 以及前 OpenAI 高管 Fidji Simo 入列，展現極強的企業治理與戰略資源背景。
儘管合約數字驚人，Nscale 在 2026 年上半年營收達 1.406 億美元(年增 1,252%)的同時，淨虧損亦擴大至 10.2 億美元。
《Startup Fortune》專欄作者 Walter Schulze 指出， Nscale 在招股書中曾警示其對「持續經營的能力存在重大疑慮」。雖然管理層主張延後部分資本支出可舒緩資金壓力，但這向監管機構證實公司曾面臨資金耗盡邊緣，這種流動性風險比單純的擴充期虧損更值得投資人警惕。
EBC Financial Group 分析師 Benny Lam 評估，350 億美元估值的合理性完全取決於能否將簽約合約轉化為實際營運收入，而非當前獲利。
Benny Lam 分析，10.2 億美元淨虧損包含 4.571 億美元的公允價值調整與 1.74 億美元折舊攤銷，實際營運虧損為 4.92 億美元。更關鍵的是，截至 2026 年 8 月底，1,034 億美元 TCV 中僅 26 億美元(約 2.5%)處於活躍狀態，46.1 萬塊 GPU 中僅 2.5 萬塊(5.4%)上線運作，未來仍面臨龐大的基礎建設融資挑戰。
paras_en: Global AI infrastructure reaches a heavyweight milestone. London‑based end‑to‑end AI compute cloud provider Nscale has filed an S‑1 with the U.S. SEC, planning to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker NSCL and raise up to $3 billion, with market estimates valuing the company at as much as $35 billion.

A star underwriting syndicate led by Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Morgan Stanley is handling the deal, and Nscale’s valuation has more than doubled in just six months, jumping from $14.6 billion at its Series C round in March 2026.

From a 16‑year‑old high‑school dropout coal miner to the CEO of a compute empire. The dramatic rise of Nscale is inseparable from its founder and CEO Josh Payne’s grassroots transformation. Payne left high school at 16, worked as a coal miner and crane operator at an Australian industrial site, then taught himself business and finance and co‑founded the Bitcoin mining firm Arkon Energy between 2019 and 2020.

When the cryptocurrency market slumped in 2023, Payne keenly sensed the GPU compute shortage sparked by the generative‑AI boom and decisively pivoted Arkon’s “low‑cost excess power + high‑density compute” mining expertise toward AI. In May 2024, Nscale was spun out of Arkon as an independent entity.
By acquiring land, Norwegian hydropower and micro‑grid assets, Nscale has achieved vertical integration of power, data centers and GPU clusters, with its power pipeline outlook now exceeding 10 GW.

Microsoft, Anthropic and ByteDance power‑binding contracts. The prospectus discloses that Nscale’s active and signed total contract value (TCV) reaches $103.4 billion, with as much as 85% of revenue tied to two major AI giants.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US): a compute‑supply agreement through 2033 worth $43.8 billion.
Anthropic: a GPU‑service contract valued between $44.6 billion and $45.0 billion, with plans to deploy Nvidia Vera Rubin chips at its West Virginia campus.

In addition, according to the Financial Times and SEC filings, ByteDance’s Singapore entity Spring (SG) Pte Ltd was an early hidden major customer, contributing 73% of Nscale’s $33 million revenue in 2025. Nscale also poached former Alibaba Cloud executive Jiny Yin to run its Asia cloud and e‑commerce business.

Nvidia heavy‑holds and star‑studded board. Chip leader Nvidia (NVDA‑US) not only owns more than 5% of Nscale but participated in a $3.1 billion convertible‑bond financing in September 2026, purchasing $1 billion of the bonds, bringing total capital support to over $2 billion. Nscale’s board includes former Meta COO Sheryl Sandberg, former Meta Global Affairs President Nick Clegg and former OpenAI executive Fidji Simo, underscoring strong governance and strategic resources.
Despite the impressive contract figures, Nscale posted first‑half‑2026 revenue of $140.6 million (a 1,252% year‑over‑year increase) while its net loss widened to $1.02 billion.

Startup Fortune columnist Walter Schulze noted that Nscale warned in its filing of “material doubts about its ability to continue as a going concern.” Although management says postponing some capital expenditures can ease cash pressure, this confirms to regulators that the company has been on the brink of cash exhaustion, a liquidity risk that investors should heed more than mere expansion‑phase losses.

EBC Financial Group analyst Benny Lam assessed that the reasonableness of a $35 billion valuation hinges entirely on converting signed contracts into actual operating revenue, not on current profitability.

Benny Lam further broke down the $1.02 billion net loss: $457.1 million stems from fair‑value adjustments and $174 million from depreciation and amortization, leaving an operating loss of $492 million. More critically, as of the end of August 2026, only $2.6 billion (about 2.5%) of the $103.4 billion TCV is active, and only 25,000 of the 461,000 GPUs (5.4%) are online, indicating a massive infrastructure financing challenge ahead.

items.title: 科技股賣壓引爆亞股拋售潮 南韓重挫觸發熔斷、日經創3月以來最大跌幅
items.title_en: Tech Stock Selling Pressure Sparks Asian Market Sell‑off; South Korea Plunges, Triggers Circuit Breaker, Nikkei Posts Largest Drop Since March
paras: 在全球科技股與晶片股劇烈修正的衝擊下，亞洲股市周四(15日)遭遇強烈賣壓。由於市場對人工智慧龐大資本支出回報與融資風險的疑慮升溫，加上美國通膨高於預期引發的聯準會升息擔憂，拖累亞股全面走低。MSCI亞太企業股價指數大跌3.2%，創下今年7月以來的收盤新低。

日韓科技股首當其衝

南韓股市成為本次拋售潮的震央，南韓KOSPI指數盤中重挫8%至9.1%，觸發今年第10次熔斷機制(Circuit Breaker)並暫停交易20分鐘，寫下7月底以來首次熔斷紀錄。
其中，半導體巨頭三星電子與SK海力士單日狂跌9.7%至11%以上。外資當天單日賣超高達2.9兆韓元(約21.5億美元)。
日本股市同樣寫下劇烈跌幅，日經225指數暴跌4.9%，收於64426點，創下自3月以來最大的單日跌幅。科技與AI概念股領跌，愛德萬測試(Advantest)重挫14.2%、鎧俠(Kioxia)下跌12.5%、雷射科技(Lasertec)大跌13.3%、軟銀集團(SoftBank Group)重挫8.9%。
滬港股走勢同樣疲軟，截至周四午盤，上海綜合指數下跌2.2%，香港恒生指數下跌1.5%，恒生科技指數重挫3.0%。

高通膨加劇升息預期 AI融資信用風險成焦點

引發本次亞洲科技股暴跌的主因，在於美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.7%，創下五個月來最快增幅，大幅提升市場對美國聯準會(Fed)進一步升息的預期。
借貸成本居高不下，使得高度依賴外部融資進行資料中心建置的AI企業面臨嚴峻的信用風險。投資人開始質疑注入AI領域的數百億美元資金能否帶來相應回報，導致資金加速從高估值科技股撤出。

市場啟動避險模式

隨著股市拋售深化，市場避險情緒大幅升溫。投資人拋售高風險資產，將資金轉入政府公債、日元、瑞士法郎及黃金等避險標的，帶動美、日、澳等國10年期公債殖利率普遍回落。
分析師指出，此波賣壓已從單純的科技股修正演變為廣泛的去風險化事件，短期內市場將持續密切關注AI供應鏈的資金籌措風險與各國央行貨幣政策動態。
paras_en: Under the shock of a sharp correction in global tech and chip stocks, Asian markets faced heavy selling pressure on Thursday (the 15th). Concerns over the massive capital‑expenditure returns and financing risks of artificial intelligence, combined with worries that higher‑than‑expected U.S. inflation could prompt further Fed rate hikes, dragged Asian equities lower across the board. The MSCI Asia‑Pacific Index fell 3.2%, hitting its lowest close since July this year.

South Korean tech stocks bore the brunt. The KOSPI slumped 8% intraday to 9,100 points, triggering the year’s tenth circuit‑breaker and halting trading for 20 minutes, marking the first circuit‑breaker activation since the end of July.
Semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix tumbled between 9.7% and over 11% in a single day. Foreign investors sold a net 2.9 trillion won (about $2.15 billion) that day.

Japan’s market also saw a steep decline, with the Nikkei 225 plunging 4.9% to close at 64,426 points, the biggest one‑day drop since March. Tech and AI‑related stocks led the losses, with Advantest down 14.2%, Kioxia falling 12.5%, Lasertec sliding 13.3% and SoftBank Group shedding 8.9%.
Shanghai and Hong Kong stocks were similarly weak; by early afternoon Thursday the Shanghai Composite was down 2.2%, the Hang Seng fell 1.5% and the Hang Seng Tech Index slumped 3.0%.
The main driver of the Asian tech sell‑off was the U.S. September CPI, which rose 3.7% year‑on‑year – the fastest increase in five months – sharply raising expectations of further Fed rate hikes.

Persistently high borrowing costs are exposing AI firms, which rely heavily on external financing for data‑center builds, to severe credit risk. Investors are questioning whether the hundreds of billions of dollars poured into AI can generate commensurate returns, prompting a rapid pull‑back from over‑valued tech stocks.

As the sell‑off deepened, hedging sentiment surged. Investors dumped high‑risk assets and shifted funds into government bonds, the yen, the Swiss franc and gold, pushing 10‑year yields in the U.S., Japan, Australia and other countries lower.

Analysts say the pressure has evolved from a pure tech correction into a broad risk‑off episode. In the short term, markets will keep a close eye on funding risks in the AI supply chain and on monetary‑policy moves by central banks worldwide.

items.title: 瑞銀維持美元「逢低買進」策略
items.title_en: UBS Maintains "Buy the Dip" Strategy for the Dollar
paras: 《Investing.com》報導，瑞銀(UBS)週三(14日)在給客戶的報告中表示，只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI投資題材持續發酵，逢美元回檔時買進仍是合適的策略。
策略師Shahab Jalinoos表示，G10貨幣市場本週走勢相對平淡，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差穩定在約140個基點。
他指出，從法國的角度來看，這個利差水準仍令人不安，也持續支持歐元兌美元應採取「逢高賣出」策略的觀點。
瑞銀預期，歐元將測試第四季的區間低點1.1050，並維持2026年底目標價1.1200不變。
Jalinoos指出，柴油價格可能接近穩定的初步跡象，為歐元提供部分支撐。然而，歐洲仍面臨風險，天然氣庫存處於異常低檔，天然氣期貨價格也升至本輪週期新高。
近期科技股走勢疲軟，可能促使美元進入部分整理階段，通膨數據也可能進一步降低市場對未來較長期間升息的預期。
他寫道，「儘管如此，我們的核心觀點仍未改變：只要能源價格維持高檔，且AI帶動的投資題材持續發酵，逢美元走低時買進仍是合適的策略。」
在商品貨幣方面，瑞銀認為，澳幣、紐幣與加幣目前處於整理階段，但由於市場對升息的定價有限，這三種貨幣都有機會收復9月的跌幅。其中，加幣是瑞銀最偏好的短線做多標的。
Jalinoos也反駁了「日本減持法國債券將推升日元」的看法。他表示，國際收支數據顯示，日本對法國債券的曝險部位已大幅下降。
paras_en: Investing.com reported that UBS on Wednesday (the 14th) said in a client report that as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑related investment themes keep developing, buying the dollar on dips remains an appropriate strategy.
Strategist Shahab Jalinoos noted that G10 currency markets were relatively flat this week, with the spread between French and German 10‑year government bond yields steady at about 140 basis points.
He pointed out that from a French perspective this spread level is still unsettling and continues to support the view that the euro versus the dollar should be sold on rallies.
UBS expects the euro to test the fourth‑quarter low of 1.1050 and keeps its year‑end‑2026 target unchanged at 1.1200.

Jalinoos said diesel prices may be showing early signs of stabilisation, offering some support to the euro. However, Europe still faces risks as natural‑gas inventories are at unusually low levels and gas futures have risen to a new high for this cycle.
Weakness in recent tech stocks could push the dollar into a partial correction, and inflation data may further reduce market expectations for prolonged rate hikes.

He wrote, "Nevertheless, our core view remains unchanged: as long as energy prices stay high and AI‑driven investment themes continue to develop, buying the dollar on its declines remains an appropriate strategy."

Regarding commodity currencies, UBS sees the Australian, New Zealand and Canadian dollars as currently in a consolidation phase, but with limited rate‑hike pricing in the market each has a chance to recover September losses. The Canadian dollar is UBS’s top short‑term long‑biased pick.

Jalinoos also rebutted the view that Japan’s reduction of French bond holdings would boost the yen, noting that balance‑of‑payments data show Japan’s exposure to French bonds has already fallen sharply.

據歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員溫施認為ECB仍需再升息，但ECB總裁拉加德表示法國應透過財政政策解決自身債券市場困境，淡化市場對ECB是否出手干預的猜測，更擔憂明年法國總統大選前政治角力可能阻礙政府削減高額赤字的努力，並據IMF敦促發達經濟體採取緊急行動削減政府支出、赤字和降低債務，而且美國CPI上漲激勵美元，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1112低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1200-20，支撐於1.1110-30。
◆GBP/USD

週三德勤(Deloitte)調查英國企業首席財務官(CFO)預計一年後通貨膨脹率升至3.4%及認為信貸成本高昂的比例創兩年半新高，而且法國財政問題衝擊歐元兌英鎊至十六個月新低，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3275高點。隨著英國央行(BOE)首席經濟學家皮爾稱市場對BOE未來一年加息四次、每次25個基點的推測過於激進，在美國CPI數據後，重創英鎊兌美元至1.3132低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3230-50，支撐於1.3130-50。
